name: 2015 LiDAR Flight Dublin City
tagline: High-resolution LiDAR and photogrammetry data for Dublin City, Ireland, provided through NYU Libraries.
description: This record provides aerial laser scanning (ALS) and photogrammetry data from a 2015 flight over Dublin, Ireland. It includes 3D point-cloud (LAZ), 3D full waveform LiDAR (LAS and Pulsewave), and ortho-rectified 2D rasters, covering over 2km² with 1.4 billion laser points.

name: 2019 LiDAR Data Collection for Sunset Park
tagline: A comprehensive aerial laser scanning and photogrammetry data collection for urban informatics research in Sunset Park, Brooklyn, NY.
description: This record serves as a portal to an extensive aerial laser scanning (ALS) and photogrammetry dataset covering approximately 1.0 km² in Sunset Park, Brooklyn, NY. The data was captured in April 2019, providing detailed representations of the urban environment. It includes LiDAR point clouds, full waveform files, and RGBI Nadir imagery for various research and practical applications.

name: 3D Elevation Program
tagline: The 3D Elevation Program (3DEP) provides high-quality topographic data and elevation products for the United States.
description: The 3D Elevation Program (3DEP) is a U.S. Geological Survey (USGS) initiative to systematically collect enhanced elevation data nationwide. It aims to generate high-resolution topographic data, primarily using lidar technology, to support a wide range of applications. This program provides critical foundational data for mapping, natural resource management, infrastructure planning, and hazard mitigation across the United States.

name: 3D Printable Civil War Battlefields
tagline: A collection of 3D printable models depicting Civil War Battlefields for historical and educational purposes.
description: This Printables.com collection, curated by dhersh, features a series of 3D printable models focused on significant Civil War battlefields. It offers a unique way to engage with historical geography, providing tangible representations of important sites for study or display.

name: 3DEP Lidar HAG on Planetary Computer
tagline: Provides access to 3D Elevation Program Lidar Height Above Ground data via Microsoft Planetary Computer.
description: This dataset offers 3D Elevation Program (3DEP) Lidar Height Above Ground (HAG) data, providing detailed elevation information. Hosted on Microsoft Planetary Computer, it enables users to access and process high-resolution lidar data for various geospatial analyses and environmental studies.

name: 99boundaries
tagline: Provides free OpenStreetMap boundaries in various file formats.
description: This website offers free OpenStreetMap (OSM) administrative and land boundaries for various countries worldwide. The boundaries are generated using Overpass and OSM Land Polygons, ensuring up-to-date and community-contributed data. Users can download these datasets in multiple popular GIS file formats.

name: ACT Open Data Portal
tagline: The official open data portal for the Australian Capital Territory, promoting accessible and shareable government data.
description: This platform serves as the official open data portal for the Australian Capital Territory (ACT) Government. It provides public access to a wide range of government datasets, supporting transparency, re-usability, and community engagement. Users can find data related to various sectors, including education, transport, safety, and geospatial information.

name: AFG Humanitarian Response MapCentre
tagline: Centralized geospatial data and maps for humanitarian operations in Afghanistan.
description: The AFG Humanitarian Response MapCentre serves as a vital platform for accessing geospatial information critical to humanitarian efforts in Afghanistan. It compiles and disseminates maps and data to support planning, coordination, and response activities across the region.

name: AGIC Geospatial Data Collections
tagline: A comprehensive directory of Arizona-specific, other state, and national geospatial data collections and resources.
description: This resource page from the Arizona Geographic Information Council (AGIC) provides links to various geospatial data collections. It serves as a central hub for discovering GIS data, interactive maps, and environmental review tools across Arizona and beyond. The site categorizes resources into Arizona, Other State, and Nationwide sections for easy navigation.

name: Alabama Open Data Portal
tagline: Alabama's public platform for exploring, downloading, and engaging with open geospatial data.
description: This portal serves as Alabama's public platform for accessing and utilizing open geospatial data. Users can explore, search, preview, and download various state and national datasets. It also highlights featured applications and encourages building new apps and sharing insights.

name: Alaska DNR Open Data
tagline: Your gateway to accessing geospatial land and resource data, applications, maps, and publications.
description: Alaska DNR Open Data provides a public platform for exploring and downloading geospatial land and resource data. It offers access to applications, maps, and publications produced and maintained by the divisions and offices of the Department of Natural Resources. Users can discover and build apps, and engage to solve important local issues within the community.

name: Alberta Geological Survey
tagline: Alberta Geological Survey Open Data Portal provides free access to geoscience data for the province.
description: The Alberta Geological Survey (AGS) Open Data Portal offers a collection of GIS data and interactive maps focused on Alberta's geology. It provides geoscience information across various domains, including surficial mapping, bedrock mapping, resource evaluation, groundwater, and geological hazards. All data is open and freely available under the Open Government License - Alberta.

name: ALOS World 3D-30m
tagline: Provides access to a high-resolution global digital elevation model for diverse geospatial applications.
description: The ALOS-DEM dataset offers a global 30-meter resolution digital elevation model, crucial for detailed terrain analysis and modeling. Hosted on the Microsoft Planetary Computer, it facilitates access to this extensive topographic data for researchers and developers. This resource supports various environmental and geographical studies.

name: amche.in
tagline: A community built collection of public maps from Goa and India.
description: amche.in is an interactive 3D atlas that allows users to explore and create various maps. It functions as a citizen-maintained digital mapping resource, offering free access to diverse geospatial data and mapping capabilities.

name: American Samoa Data Portal
tagline: A data portal providing Geographic Information System (GIS) datasets for American Samoa's Coastal and Marine Spatial Planning (CMSP).
description: This portal offers a centralized repository for GIS data relevant to American Samoa's Coastal and Marine Spatial Planning (CMSP) initiatives. Users can explore a variety of datasets, including physical geography, elevation, and bathymetry, with options to view screenshots, access metadata, and download data. Selected datasets are also available via REST services, WMS, or interactive mapping interfaces.

name: Antarctic Digital Database Viewer
tagline: A comprehensive digital database viewer for Antarctic geographic information.
description: The Antarctic Digital Database Viewer provides access to fundamental geospatial datasets for the Antarctic continent. It allows users to explore and download a range of geographical features, crucial for research, mapping, and environmental monitoring in the region. This platform is a key resource for understanding Antarctic geography.

name: AquaMaps
tagline: AquaMaps provides predicted range maps for aquatic species, offering valuable biodiversity information.
description: This platform generates standardized, computer-generated predictions of marine and freshwater species ranges globally. It serves as a resource for exploring aquatic biodiversity and species distribution for research and non-commercial applications.

name: ArcticDEM
tagline: High-resolution digital surface models of the Arctic derived from optical stereo imagery for detailed topographic analysis.
description: ArcticDEM is an NGA-NSF initiative providing high-resolution Digital Surface Models (DSM) of the Arctic. It leverages optical stereo imagery from Maxar satellites and open-source photogrammetry software to produce elevation data. This dataset supports accurate measurement of topographic change and environmental monitoring in remote polar regions.

name: Arkansas GIS Office
tagline: Providing geospatial data, mapping applications, and GIS programs for the state of Arkansas.
description: The Arkansas GIS Office manages the state's spatial data infrastructure, offering a central repository for various GIS datasets. It provides essential mapping applications and supports state and local government initiatives through specialized geospatial programs and data services.

name: ASF SAR Data Products for Disaster Events
tagline: A curated collection of Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) data for monitoring and assessing disaster events.
description: This resource provides Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) and SAR-derived satellite data products from various sources, specifically curated for disaster events. It offers valuable insights for researchers, scientists, and emergency response teams, with irregular updates in response to new disasters. The data is managed by the Alaska Satellite Facility (ASF).

name: ASU GeoData
tagline: ASU GeoData is a platform for discovering and exploring geospatial datasets, maps, and aerial imagery curated by the ASU Library.
description: This platform empowers researchers to navigate and access the dynamic world of geospatial information. It serves as a central hub for discovering, exploring, and downloading datasets, maps, and aerial imagery. The site also connects users to additional GIS data portals across Arizona, including those from ASU research initiatives and various state and local government agencies.

name: Atlas of Namibia
tagline: A comprehensive digital atlas providing geospatial data and information for Namibia from Project E1.
description: This digital atlas, developed as part of Project E1 by the University of Cologne, offers a rich collection of geospatial information for Namibia. It provides detailed insights across various thematic areas, making complex geographical data accessible. The atlas serves as a valuable resource for research and educational purposes focused on the region.

name: AVIRIS
tagline: The Airborne Visible Infrared Imaging Spectrometer (AVIRIS) provides critical Earth observation data for environmental research.
description: The Airborne Visible Infrared Imaging Spectrometer (AVIRIS) is a NASA JPL instrument designed to collect hyperspectral imagery of Earth's surface. It plays a crucial role in various scientific research missions, monitoring environmental impacts, natural hazards, and ecological changes across diverse landscapes. The project offers access to collected data, flight planning information, and research publications.

name: Awesome Geospatial Embeddings
tagline: A curated list of papers focusing on geospatial embeddings for Earth data representation.
description: This GitHub repository provides a comprehensive, curated list of academic papers dedicated to geospatial embeddings. It explores various methods for representing Earth data—spatial, temporal, and semantic—within embedding spaces, examining their behavior and applications. The collection aims to be a valuable resource for researchers and practitioners interested in the intersection of machine learning and geospatial science.

name: Awesome-DEM
tagline: Overview of Digital Elevation Model (DEM) datasets
description: This GitHub repository provides a comprehensive overview of Digital Elevation Model (DEM) datasets. It categorizes various global and local DEMs, including open and proprietary options, and distinguishes between DEM, DSM, and DTM concepts. The resource also lists relevant papers, portals, and discussions for further exploration of elevation data.

name: awesome-forests
tagline: A curated list of ground-truth forest datasets for machine learning and forestry research.
description: This GitHub repository provides a curated list of ground-truth forest datasets for the machine learning and forestry community. It focuses on in-situ and validation data for various analyses, including biodiversity, carbon, and wildfire. The goal is to help researchers and practitioners easily find datasets for building machine learning models for forest analysis.

name: awesome-gee-community-catalog
tagline: A community-driven catalog of datasets for Google Earth Engine.
description: This website serves as a comprehensive catalog for community datasets accessible within Google Earth Engine. It provides users with organized access to a wide array of geospatial data, along with resources to facilitate their exploration and utilization. The platform also features tutorials, publications, and tools for getting started with GEE community assets.

name: AWS Open Data Geo
tagline: A curated list of open geospatial datasets available on AWS.
description: This GitHub repository compiles a comprehensive list of open geospatial datasets hosted on Amazon Web Services (AWS). It serves as a valuable resource for developers, researchers, and data scientists seeking readily available geospatial data for various applications and projects, streamlining access to critical information.

name: AZGeo
tagline: Arizona's authoritative geospatial repository providing free access to data and GIS tools.
description: AZGeo Data Hub, an initiative of the Arizona Geographic Information Council (AGIC) and the Arizona State Land Department, serves as Arizona’s authoritative geospatial repository. It offers online map services, FGDC compliant metadata, geospatial data downloads, and applications for various governmental, private, and public users. Registered users also gain free access to ArcGIS Online GIS tools, fostering collaboration among geospatial professionals statewide.

name: Base Adresse Nationale
tagline: The official national address platform for France, providing comprehensive address data and tools.
description: This platform serves as the central hub for the Base Adresse Nationale (BAN) and the Base Adresse Locale (BAL) in France. It offers official, standardized address data, making it accessible for various uses. The site provides resources, documentation, and tools for managing, validating, and utilizing address information across French communes.

name: BD ORTHO®
tagline: The official geographical image of the French national territory, offering a sky-high view of France.
description: BD ORTHO® provides high-resolution orthorectified imagery, serving as a key digital reference tool for local authorities and ministries across France. Updated regularly, this data enriches the visualization of professional data and projects.

name: BD TOPO®
tagline: Comprehensive 2D and 3D vector modeling of French territory and infrastructure.
description: BD TOPO® provides a detailed 3D vector description of France's territory and infrastructure with metric precision, suitable for scales from 1:2,000 to 1:50,000. It covers all national geographic and administrative entities, supporting visualization, positioning, and simulation for territorial analysis and operational management.

name: beaconDB
tagline: beaconDB provides a public domain wireless geolocation database, ethically sourced and privacy-friendly, for various location services.
description: This platform offers a public domain database for wireless geolocation, aggregating data from Wi-Fi networks, cell towers, and beacons across numerous countries. It emphasizes ethical data sourcing through opt-in collection, protects privacy by obfuscating published information, and ensures data integrity with abuse-resistant update mechanisms. The database supports integration via an API and various client applications.

name: Bedmap2
tagline: A comprehensive dataset providing the bed topography, ice thickness, and surface elevation of the Antarctic continent.
description: Bedmap2 is a collaborative project that compiles and makes available a detailed dataset of Antarctica's subglacial topography, ice thickness, and surface elevation. This crucial data is derived from various airborne and ground-based geophysical measurements, offering an enhanced understanding of the continent's ice sheet dynamics and potential sea-level rise contributions. It serves as a fundamental resource for glaciological and climate research.

name: BERDS - Spatial Data Warehouse
tagline: A spatial data warehouse offering baseline ArcGIS shapefiles for Belize's environmental and planning initiatives.
description: The Biodiversity and Environmental Resource Data System of Belize (BERDS) provides a spatial data warehouse component. It offers baseline ArcGIS shapefiles, primarily in UTM NAD 1927 Z16N format, for various societal, planning, conservation, and education initiatives within Belize. Users can download these datasets, which include full ArcGIS v.10 metadata, for free, with a requirement to reference BERDS in any publications.

name: Bhuvan NRSC Open EO Data Archive
tagline: Bhuvan is NRSC's Open Earth Observation Data Archive, providing free GIS data including Ortho, DEM, and satellite imagery.
description: Bhuvan is a comprehensive geospatial portal from the National Remote Sensing Centre (NRSC), offering open access to Earth Observation data. It provides a wide array of free GIS data products such as orthoimagery, Digital Elevation Models (DEM), and satellite imagery from various Indian sensors like AWiFS, LISSIII, and HySI. Users can download these datasets for diverse applications and explore web mapping tools within the platform.

name: Biodiversity BGIS
tagline: A comprehensive portal for biodiversity and ecosystem spatial data and environmental assessment guidelines in South Africa.
description: This website serves as a central hub for spatial datasets related to biodiversity and ecosystems within South Africa and surrounding regions. It provides access to critical data layers for environmental planning and conservation efforts. Additionally, the platform offers best practice guidelines for species environmental assessments, supporting standardized approaches in Environmental Impact Assessments.

name: BiodiversityMapping.org
tagline: Explore the variety of life with the latest biodiversity maps, including birds, mammals, amphibians, and marine species.
description: BiodiversityMapping.org offers an extensive collection of global and regional maps showcasing the distribution of various species. It provides detailed visualizations for terrestrial and marine biodiversity, covering a wide array of taxa. Users can access and download GIS data for further analysis, making it a valuable resource for research and conservation efforts.

name: BON in a Box
tagline: A comprehensive platform providing tools, protocols, and project registration for global biodiversity observation and analysis.
description: BON in a Box offers an interactive pipeline engine to calculate Essential Biodiversity Variables (EBVs) and biodiversity indicators. It provides access to observation design, data collection protocols, and tools for data management, analysis, and reporting, alongside a portal for registering monitoring projects.

name: Boston Plans
tagline: The GIS Lab provides mapping and analytical support for the Planning Department and beyond.
description: Boston Plans, through its GIS Lab, is a pivotal resource for urban planning and development in the city. It specializes in providing comprehensive mapping and analytical support, crucial for informed decision-making across various departments. The organization focuses on leveraging 3D data and advanced mapping technologies to enhance understanding of Boston's built and natural environments.

name: British Geological Survey
tagline: Providing online access to geological data and material collections through web services and APIs.
description: The British Geological Survey (BGS) offers comprehensive access to its vast geological data and material collections. This is achieved through a suite of dedicated online databases, web services, and application programming interfaces (APIs), enabling users to integrate and utilize BGS information.

name: C-CAP High-Resolution Land Cover
tagline: Provides high-resolution C-CAP land cover data for coastal areas across the nation.
description: The NOAA Office for Coastal Management provides C-CAP High-Resolution Land Cover data through its Digital Coast initiative. This resource offers detailed land cover information, including up to 25 classification categories, for most coastal areas nationwide. Data is available at 1 to 2.4-meter resolution, with 1-meter data recently released.

name: CACES
tagline: Providing data on air pollutant concentrations and health impacts across the contiguous U.S.
description: The Center for Air, Climate, & Energy Solutions (CACES) offers comprehensive data on outdoor concentrations of criteria and non-criteria air pollutants across the contiguous U.S. This resource also provides results from health impact models (AP2, EASIUR, InMAP) quantifying economic damages from air pollution exposure based on emission locations.

name: Cal-Adapt Wildfire Projections
tagline: Wildfire projections for California to support climate resilience and grid operations.
description: This dataset provides wildfire projections for California and its surrounding areas, developed to support California's Fifth Climate Assessment. It integrates historical weather observations and renewable energy capacity profiles, aiding in climate resilience and grid operations planning. The data is managed by Cal-Adapt: Analytics Engine.

name: California State Geoportal
tagline: Discover, analyze, and download government geospatial data from the California State Geoportal.
description: This geoportal provides access to a wide range of California state government geospatial data. Users can discover, analyze, and download datasets in various formats like CSV, KML, GeoJSON, and GeoTIFF. It also offers API links for GeoServices, WMS, and WFS, supporting data integration and analysis.

name: California State Lands Commission
tagline: The official open data hub for the California State Lands Commission, offering public GIS data, maps, and applications.
description: This hub provides a vast array of free public GIS data resources from the California State Lands Commission. Users can explore maps, applications, and geographic datasets to gain valuable insights. It supports informed decision-making across the commission by offering readily accessible geospatial information.

name: Canadian Hydrographic Service - NONNA
tagline: Provides Canadian hydrographic data for non-navigational purposes under a specific license.
description: The Canadian Hydrographic Service (CHS) NONNA platform offers access to hydrographic data. This data is explicitly not intended for navigational purposes, and users must adhere to a specific license agreement for its acquisition and use.

name: Canadian Soil Information Service
tagline: A national service providing comprehensive soil data and information for Canada.
description: The Canadian Soil Information Service (CanSIS) is a vital national resource dedicated to collecting, managing, and disseminating soil data across Canada. It serves as a central hub for researchers, policymakers, and the public to access critical information essential for agricultural planning, environmental monitoring, and land resource management. This service plays a key role in understanding and preserving Canada's soil resources.

name: CanElevation
tagline: Provides Canada Digital Elevation Models (DEMs) including DTM, DSM, and derived products at 1m, 2m, and 30m resolutions.
description: CanElevation offers comprehensive Digital Elevation Models for Canada, encompassing Digital Terrain Models (DTM), Digital Surface Models (DSM), and other derived products. The dataset features resolutions of 1m, 2m, and 30m, integrating data from airborne LiDAR, optical digital images, and Copernicus DEM from the TanDEM-X Mission to ensure complete national coverage.

name: Cartesius
tagline: A geospatial data portal providing access to a wide range of geographic information for Belgium.
description: Cartesius serves as a central online portal for discovering and accessing geospatial data relevant to Belgium. It offers users a consolidated entry point to various geographic datasets and services, facilitating the use of spatial information for diverse applications.

name: CCAFS Climate
tagline: Provides statistically downscaled future climate projections derived from IPCC assessment reports.
description: This platform offers access to statistically downscaled future climate projections, along with data related to bias correction, spatial downscaling, and weather station information. It serves as a resource for researchers and practitioners needing detailed climate data for various analyses and applications.

name: CDrone
tagline: CDrone provides a synthetic drone dataset and data augmentation for monocular 3D object detection.
description: CDrone introduces the CARLA Drone dataset, expanding camera perspectives for monocular 3D object detection benchmarks. It also develops GroundMix, an effective data augmentation pipeline that significantly boosts detection accuracy. This work aims to encourage progress in 3D detection frameworks.

name: Census Bureau Data
tagline: Explore, customize, and download official data about America's people, places, and economy.
description: This official United States Census Bureau platform provides comprehensive data on America's people, places, and economy. Users can explore, customize, and download various data assets, including tables, maps, charts, profiles, and microdata. It offers tools to build customized maps and access detailed community profiles across numerous geographies.

name: Census Mapping Files
tagline: Provides access to geographic information files from the U.S. Census Bureau for mapping and analysis.
description: The U.S. Census Bureau offers various mapping files for download, enabling users to integrate geographical information into their GIS projects. Available formats include Shapefiles (Partnership, TIGER/Line, Cartographic Boundary), KML, and File Geodatabase files. These resources support data visualization, analysis, and research related to U.S. demographic and economic data.

name: Census Subdivision Boundary File
tagline: Provides Canada's census subdivision boundaries for mapping and geographic analysis.
description: This file contains the boundaries of all census subdivisions across Canada, which are municipalities or equivalent areas like Indian reserves and unorganized territories. It offers a crucial framework for geographic analysis and mapping using various GIS and mapping software. A comprehensive reference guide is also included with the file.

name: Center For Hazards & Risk Research
tagline: Provides freely available global core data sets for natural disaster hotspots, including hazard frequency, distribution, and risk analysis.
description: This platform offers a comprehensive collection of core data sets related to Natural Disaster Hotspots – A Global Risk Analysis. These data sets are freely available for download and include information on hazard frequency, distribution, mortality risks, and economic loss deciles for various natural disasters. The data is provided in common GIS-compatible formats to facilitate research and analysis.

name: Chalmers Cloud Ice Climatology
tagline: A novel, deep-learning-based climate record of ice-particle concentrations in the atmosphere.
description: The Chalmers Cloud Ice Climatology (CCIC) provides a deep-learning-based climate record of atmospheric ice-particle concentrations. This dataset offers high spatial and temporal resolution, making it suitable for evaluating weather and climate models or studying individual weather systems. It is updated quarterly and available under a CC BY 4.0 license.

name: Chesapeake Bay Program Data
tagline: A comprehensive data hub providing access to monitoring and modeling data for the Chesapeake Bay ecosystem.
description: This platform offers access to a wide array of current and historical monitoring and modeling data related to the Chesapeake Bay. Users can query databases using parameters like geographic region and date range, with results available as downloadable text files for further analysis. A robust Quality Assurance Program ensures the accuracy of environmental datasets.

name: City of Houston GIS
tagline: MyCity Houston GIS Online provides geographic reference and services for the public.
description: This portal offers a variety of GIS applications and open data for the City of Houston, serving as a public service for geographic reference. It includes tools for crime statistics, land use, council member lookup, and solid waste collection schedules. The site also provides access to historical maps and planning resources for the community.

name: City of Toronto
tagline: The City of Toronto provides a comprehensive open data portal for public access to various municipal datasets.
description: This platform offers a wide array of datasets covering city services, community information, and economic development. It serves as a central hub for researchers, developers, and citizens to access and utilize public information from Toronto's municipal government.

name: Civil War Battlefield Boundaries
tagline: A National Park Service repository providing references and data, including Civil War battlefield boundaries.
description: The NPS DataStore is a comprehensive online repository managed by the National Park Service (NPS) for integrated resource management data and references. This specific profile provides detailed citation information for "Civil War Battlefield Boundaries," a public reference.

name: Climate Change Knowledge Portal
tagline: A global hub for climate-related data, insights, and knowledge resources from the World Bank.
description: The Climate Change Knowledge Portal serves as a central repository for global climate data, encompassing historical and future climate projections, vulnerabilities, and impacts. It provides a platform to access country, subnational, and watershed-level climate information, facilitating informed decision-making for development.

name: Climate Watch
tagline: Open data, visualizations, and analysis for understanding global climate progress and emissions.
description: Climate Watch provides comprehensive open data, visualizations, and analytical tools for policymakers, researchers, and stakeholders. It offers insights into countries' climate progress, including Nationally Determined Contributions (NDCs), Long-Term Strategies (LTS), and Net-Zero Targets, aligning with the Paris Agreement.

name: ClimateNA, ClimateEU, ClimateAF, ClimateSA
tagline: Current, historical, and projected climate data for North America, South America, Europe, and Africa.
description: This service provides current, historical, and projected climate data for North America, South America, Europe, and Africa. Users can download interpolated data grids at 1km and 5km resolution or utilize software packages to query specific point locations. The platform also offers numerous derived variables like drought indices and growing degree days.

name: CLMS portfolio
tagline: The Copernicus Land Monitoring Service provides access to a portfolio of satellite-derived land monitoring products for Europe.
description: The Copernicus Land Monitoring Service (CLMS) offers a comprehensive portfolio of satellite-derived products for land monitoring across Europe. This includes full-coverage land cover and use data, land cover in priority areas, and bio-geophysical variables, supporting environmental policies and sustainable resource management. The service provides access to a dataset catalogue and a data viewer for exploring available products like EU-DEM.

name: CNIG Download Center
tagline: The official download center for geographical information from Spain's National Geographic Institute.
description: This platform provides access to a wide range of geospatial data and cartographic products from the Instituto Geográfico Nacional (IGN) and Centro Nacional de Información Geográfica (CNIG) of Spain. Users can download various types of geographical information for diverse applications.

name: CNMI Data Portal
tagline: Data portal for the Commonwealth of the Northern Mariana Islands, offering GIS datasets for various physical geography topics.
description: This data portal provides geospatial information for the Commonwealth of the Northern Mariana Islands (CNMI). Users can view screenshots, examine metadata, and download various GIS datasets related to physical geography, including islands, shorelines, elevation, and bathymetry. Some datasets also offer interactive mapping interfaces for exploration.

name: Coastal Elevation Models
tagline: Providing coastal digital elevation models for environmental monitoring and hazard mitigation.
description: This NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information (NCEI) resource offers coastal digital elevation models (DEMs). These DEMs are crucial for researchers and decision-makers to understand and predict environmental changes affecting coastal regions, supporting various critical monitoring activities.

name: Colorado GIS Data
tagline: A comprehensive portal for accessing geospatial data from various Colorado state agencies.
description: This website serves as a central hub for discovering GIS data pertaining to the state of Colorado. It aggregates links to data resources from multiple state departments, including Local Affairs, Natural Resources, and Oil and Gas Conservation. Users can find a diverse range of geospatial datasets, primarily in shapefile format, covering various administrative boundaries, environmental features, and infrastructure.

name: Computer Vision Group - Datasets
tagline: Providing diverse datasets for research in computer vision, image processing, and pattern recognition.
description: The Computer Vision Group at TUM offers a variety of datasets for researchers in computer vision, image processing, and pattern recognition. These datasets are shared to foster academic collaboration, with a request to cite the relevant publications when utilized.

name: Connecticut Data
tagline: An open data portal providing maps and geospatial data from Connecticut state agencies.
description: Connecticut Data is an open data portal for the state of Connecticut, offering access to a wide range of datasets. It specifically highlights maps and geospatial information published by various state agencies. Users can browse data by view type, category, agency, or tags.

name: Copernicus Browser
tagline: Browse and download full resolution satellite imagery from all Copernicus missions globally.
description: The Copernicus Browser offers a comprehensive platform for exploring and acquiring high-resolution images from the entire suite of Copernicus missions. Users can easily navigate to areas of interest, specify time ranges and data collections, and visualize the resulting data directly within the browser. It supports various visualisations, high-resolution image downloads, timelapse creation, and raw data access for local processing.

name: Copernicus Browser
tagline: An open-source search and analysis tool for Copernicus satellite imagery within the Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem.
description: Copernicus Browser is a powerful open-source web application designed for searching, visualizing, and analyzing satellite imagery from Sentinel-1, 2, 3, and 5P missions. It enables users to explore vast Earth Observation datasets, tweak rendering parameters, and download raw data or create custom visualizations. The platform is an integral part of the Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem, providing free access to advanced geospatial features for end-users.

name: Copernicus Digital Elevation Model (DEM)
tagline: A global Digital Surface Model (DSM) providing elevation data at 30 and 90-meter resolutions.
description: The Copernicus DEM is a Digital Surface Model (DSM) representing the Earth's surface, including buildings, infrastructure, and vegetation. It offers two instances: GLO-90 with worldwide 90-meter coverage and GLO-30 Public with limited worldwide 30-meter coverage. Data is available as Cloud Optimized GeoTIFFs, sourced from the Copernicus DEM 2021 release.

name: Coral Reef Image Classification Data
tagline: A community-sourced repository providing standardized, machine-learning-ready imagery and annotations for coral reef conservation.
description: This dataset offers a continually updated, community-sourced repository of coral reef image classification training data. Hosted on AWS S3, it provides standardized, machine-learning-ready imagery and annotations to support global coral reef conservation efforts. The resource facilitates collaborative ML model development across scientific and conservation communities.

name: CORONA Satellite Photographs
tagline: Historic CORONA satellite photographs from the U.S. Geological Survey, accessible via NASA's Earthdata CMR.
description: This resource provides access to historic CORONA satellite photographs, a collection of declassified imagery from early reconnaissance missions. Hosted by the U.S. Geological Survey and indexed through NASA's Earthdata Common Metadata Repository (CMR), these images offer valuable insights into historical land surface conditions.

name: County Of Los Angeles Enterprise GIS
tagline: An Esri Hub site for sharing and visualizing spatial data for Los Angeles County users and the public.
description: This Esri Hub site serves as the central platform for the LA County Enterprise GIS (eGIS) Program. It facilitates the sharing and visualization of authoritative spatial data and technology for both internal LA County users and the general public. The platform supports the county's vision by providing innovative tools and projects to enhance public services and improve outcomes for citizens.

name: CRU Data
tagline: Access to climate data from the Climatic Research Unit.
description: The Climatic Research Unit (CRU) at the University of East Anglia is a world-renowned center for climate change research. This page likely provides access to its extensive collection of climate datasets, instrumental records, and reconstructions.

name: CSA GIS Data Warehouse
tagline: Explore our open data and tools, and use it to build insights of your own.
description: This website serves as the CSA GIS Data Warehouse, an open data portal sponsored by the Center for Spatial Analysis at the University of Oklahoma. It provides free public maps and geospatial data, along with various tools, to facilitate insights for users.

name: CSO PxStat Open Data Platform
tagline: The Central Statistics Office's open data portal provides free access to statistical data in reusable formats.
description: This is the official Open Data portal of the Central Statistics Office (CSO) of Ireland. It provides access to a wide array of statistical data, including economic, social, and environmental indicators, in open, free, and reusable formats. Users can explore, search, and download datasets for various analyses.

name: CT DEEP GIS Open Data
tagline: Providing public access to Connecticut's environmental and geographic information through an open data portal.
description: This portal provides public access to the Connecticut Department of Energy & Environmental Protection's (DEEP) Geographic Information Systems (GIS) data. It serves DEEP's mission to protect and preserve the environment by offering a statewide system for integrating and analyzing spatial data. The platform shares authoritative geospatial information with various governmental agencies.

name: CT ECO
tagline: A portal for Connecticut's environmental data, maps, and GIS services.
description: Connecticut Environmental Conditions Online (CT ECO) provides access to a wealth of geospatial information focusing on Connecticut's environment. Users can explore various map viewers, browse a catalog of static PDF maps by town, and connect to map services using GIS software. The platform also offers direct downloads of GIS files for further analysis and integration.

name: CTDOT Open Data
tagline: Easily search for the latest transportation data and geospatial content from the Connecticut Department of Transportation.
description: This platform provides public access to transportation data and geospatial content published by the Connecticut Department of Transportation. Users can discover, analyze, and quickly display content, including featured and newest applications. The portal emphasizes transparency and accessibility, offering a central hub for state transportation information.

name: Danmarks Miljøportal
tagline: A public-private partnership supporting digital environmental management in Denmark.
description: Danmarks Miljøportal is a collaborative public partnership owned by the Danish state, municipalities, and regions. Its core mission is to facilitate and support digital environmental administration and management throughout Denmark. The platform aims to centralize and streamline access to environmental data and tools for public authorities, fostering efficient environmental governance.

name: DASC: Kansas GeoPortal
tagline: The Kansas Data Access & Support Center (DASC) provides a central GeoPortal for downloading and accessing Kansas geospatial data.
description: DASC serves as the official State of Kansas GIS data clearinghouse, archiving and distributing authoritative geospatial data from trusted sources. It offers a comprehensive GeoPortal Hub for downloading GIS and map data, including LiDAR and imagery, alongside various geospatial technical services and application hosting for state agencies and partners.

name: Data Basin
tagline: A science-based mapping and analysis platform supporting learning, research, and sustainable environmental stewardship.
description: Data Basin is a science-based mapping and analysis platform designed to support learning, research, and sustainable environmental stewardship. It provides an online environment for users to explore, map, and analyze various geospatial datasets. The platform aims to enhance understanding and collaboration in conservation and environmental science.

name: Data Catalogue
tagline: Explore thousands of British Columbia government datasets available in a wide variety of file formats.
description: The Data Catalogue is the official portal for accessing government datasets from British Columbia, Canada. It allows users to browse a vast collection of information and provides enhanced access to additional data upon logging in with an IDIR account.

name: data.gov.uk
tagline: The official portal for open government data in the United Kingdom.
description: Data.gov.uk is the official UK government portal for finding open data. It provides access to datasets published by central government, local authorities, and various public bodies, enabling users to build products and services.

name: Data.SA
tagline: Data.SA is the official open data portal for the Government of South Australia, providing access to a wide range of public datasets.
description: This website serves as the central hub for accessing open data published by the South Australian government. It offers a catalog of datasets, information on contributing organizations, and showcases applications developed using the data. The portal aims to enhance transparency and foster innovation through public access to government information.

name: Dataforsyningen
tagline: Access comprehensive Danish geospatial data, including basemaps, elevation models, buildings, and roads, available via webservices and direct download.
description: Dataforsyningen serves as a central hub for geospatial information in Denmark, offering a wide array of datasets for various applications. Users can find detailed information, visualize data on maps, and access data through webservices like WMS/WMTS or direct downloads in formats such as GeoTIFF. The platform supports both public administration and private use cases.

name: DataMapWales
tagline: A central source for public sector data and maps in Wales.
description: DataMapWales provides a central source for public sector geospatial data in Wales, serving both the general public and public authorities. Users can browse a comprehensive catalogue of spatial data, view pre-made maps, and download datasets for independent analysis.

name: DataVic
tagline: Discover and access Victorian Government open data assets.
description: DataVic serves as the official open data portal for the Victorian Government in Australia. It provides a centralized platform for the public to find and access a wide range of data assets from various organizations across the Victorian public sector. The portal aims to enhance transparency and foster innovation by making government data readily available.

name: Daymet
tagline: Daily gridded estimates of key meteorological and hydrological parameters for North America.
description: Daymet provides daily gridded estimates of minimum and maximum temperature, precipitation, humidity, shortwave radiation, and snow water equivalent. Data is available at a 1 km x 1 km spatial resolution for North America, offering critical environmental insights for research and applications.

name: DE FirstMap Delaware
tagline: Discover Delaware's Data
description: The DE FirstMap Delaware Hub provides a centralized platform for accessing diverse geospatial datasets for the state of Delaware. It enables users to explore, visualize, and download critical geographic information. This resource supports various applications, from government planning to public research, fostering data-driven decision-making.

name: Defra data services platform
tagline: Defra group provides a Data Services Platform to make environmental data openly available to a wide range of users.
description: Defra group provides a Data Services Platform to make environmental data openly available. The platform aims to inform actions and decisions that safeguard the natural environment, support food and farming, and sustain the rural economy. Data is accessible via APIs, spatial services, and for direct download.

name: DelawareView
tagline: A comprehensive portal for geospatial data and GIS clearinghouses in Delaware.
description: This website serves as a central hub for discovering and accessing various GIS data sources and clearinghouses specific to the state of Delaware. It provides direct links to county-level GIS portals, state environmental monitoring data, historical maps, and crucial census information, catering to a diverse user base.

name: Descarga de geodatos
tagline: Access and download a variety of geospatial data for Puerto Rico, covering environmental, administrative, and economic themes.
description: This official geodata portal provides free access to a comprehensive collection of geospatial datasets for Puerto Rico. Users can download data categorized into environmental, grid, delimitation, and economic development themes to support planning, research, and analysis. The platform serves as a vital resource for authoritative geographic information.

name: Descarga de Geodatos PR
tagline: Access and download a wide range of geospatial data for Puerto Rico, covering environmental, geological, and land use themes.
description: This platform serves as a central repository for geospatial data pertaining to Puerto Rico. It offers various datasets for download, supporting environmental analysis, land management, and research initiatives across the island. The site is maintained by the Oficina de Gerencia y Presupuesto de Puerto Rico.

name: Diamond Bay Research
tagline: A comprehensive collection of geographic data and historical GIS resources, primarily focused on Asia.
description: Diamond Bay Research provides access to a wide array of geographic data, primarily focusing on historical and modern GIS resources for Asia, particularly China and Japan. The collection includes diverse datasets ranging from administrative boundaries and historical maps to environmental data and placenames, often hosted on Harvard Dataverse.

name: Digital Earth Africa
tagline: Transforming Earth Observation Data into Insights for Africa's Sustainable Growth.
description: Digital Earth Africa delivers decision-ready Earth observation products to address social, environmental, and economic challenges across Africa. It processes openly accessible and freely available data to produce actionable insights, enhancing capacity and fostering innovation for sustainable development.

name: Digital Earth Africa Sentinel-2 Level-2A
tagline: Provides analysis-ready Level-2A Sentinel-2 satellite imagery for the African continent on AWS.
description: This dataset offers Digital Earth Africa Sentinel-2 Level-2A bottom-of-atmosphere reflectance data covering the African continent. Derived from the European Union Copernicus Sentinel-2 mission, it provides analysis-ready data ideal for various research and applications. New scenes are added regularly, usually within hours of their availability from Copernicus OpenHub.

name: Données Québec
tagline: The open data portal born from the collaboration between cities and the Government of Quebec.
description: This portal provides access to open data from Quebec, Canada. It facilitates collaboration between municipalities and the provincial government to share a wide range of datasets. Users can explore various categories of data, find organizations, and discover applications built using the available information.

name: DOV Verkenner
tagline: Explore and visualize extensive subsurface data for the Flanders region.
description: The DOV Verkenner (Explorer) is a web-based portal developed by the Flemish government, providing interactive access to the Databank Ondergrond Vlaanderen. It allows users to explore, visualize, and query extensive subsurface data relevant to geology, hydrogeology, and geotechnics across the Flanders region.

name: DWEE NE
tagline: A resource for Nebraska's water, energy, and environmental data and interactive maps.
description: This website serves as a central hub for geospatial data related to water, energy, and environmental resources within Nebraska. It offers various interactive maps and data retrieval tools, allowing users to explore information on dam safety, floodplains, groundwater, and surface water. The portal provides access to critical environmental information for public use and research.

name: Earth Engine Data Catalog
tagline: A multi-petabyte catalog of satellite imagery and geospatial datasets with planetary-scale analysis capabilities.
description: Google Earth Engine provides a comprehensive data catalog for scientists, researchers, and developers. It combines a vast collection of satellite imagery and geospatial datasets with powerful analysis tools. Users can detect changes, map trends, and quantify differences on the Earth's surface at a planetary scale.

name: EarthDEM
tagline: Provides 2m GSD Digital Elevation Models and mosaics from 2002 to the present for non-polar regions.
description: EarthDEM offers 2m GSD Digital Elevation Models (DEMs) and mosaics, created from Maxar optical imagery since 2002. This project aims to deliver high-resolution, time-series elevation data for non-polar areas, enabling change detection and comparative topographic analysis. A portion of this global dataset is publicly available on AWS.

name: EarthEnv
tagline: Global, remote-sensing supported environmental layers for assessing status and trends in biodiversity, ecosystems, and climate.
description: This platform provides global, remote-sensing supported environmental layers crucial for assessing biodiversity, ecosystems, and climate. It features a unique 1-km cloud cover dataset derived from 15 years of twice-daily MODIS satellite observations. The data offers insights into spatio-temporal cloud cover dynamics for ecological research and habitat mapping.

name: Earthenv Habitat Heterogeneity
tagline: Global, remote-sensing supported environmental layers for assessing status and trends in biodiversity, ecosystems, and climate.
description: This resource offers global datasets quantifying spatial heterogeneity of terrestrial habitats. Utilizing textural features from MODIS Enhanced Vegetation Index (EVI) imagery, it provides 14 distinct metrics at multiple resolutions. These layers are crucial for researchers and modelers focused on biodiversity and ecosystem assessments.

name: EarthEnv-DEM90
tagline: Global, remote-sensing supported environmental layers for assessing status and trends in biodiversity, ecosystems, and climate.
description: EarthEnv-DEM90 provides a nearly-global, void-free, 90m digital elevation model derived from fused ASTER and SRTM data. It offers continuous coverage for approximately 91% of the globe, supporting assessments of biodiversity, ecosystems, and climate.

name: Earthquake Hazards Program
tagline: The U.S. Geological Survey's Earthquake Hazards Program monitors, researches, and mitigates earthquake risks.
description: This program, managed by the U.S. Geological Survey, is dedicated to understanding earthquake processes and reducing their impacts across the United States and globally. It provides critical scientific information, data, and tools to assess seismic activity, evaluate hazards, and inform public safety and policy.

name: EarthStat
tagline: GIS data for agriculture and the environment.
description: EarthStat provides global GIS data sets focused on agriculture and the environment. It offers detailed information on cropland and pasture areas, harvested areas and yields for numerous crops, and greenhouse gas emissions from agricultural activities. The platform also analyzes climate variation effects on crop yields and water depletion.

name: Ecopia AI
tagline: High-precision 3D map data and geospatial feature extraction using AI.
description: Ecopia AI specializes in converting high-resolution imagery into precise 3D vector map data at scale using artificial intelligence. This technology creates a foundational geospatial digital twin, providing detailed insights for various industries and applications. They offer products like 3D land cover, building-based geocoding, and advanced transportation features.

name: Ecoregions 2017
tagline: An interactive web map for exploring global terrestrial ecoregions.
description: This website offers an interactive web mapping application displaying the Ecoregions 2017 dataset. Users can navigate and zoom across a global map to visualize and understand the distribution of terrestrial ecoregions. It provides a visual tool for environmental research and conservation efforts.

name: ECOSTRESS Data Resources
tagline: A comprehensive guide to finding, accessing, and working with NASA ECOSTRESS data for Earth science applications.
description: This GitHub repository serves as a central hub for information on the ECOsystem Spaceborne Thermal Radiometer Experiment on Space Station (ECOSTRESS) mission. It provides essential resources and guidance for users to effectively locate, retrieve, and process ECOSTRESS data products for various scientific analyses and applications.

name: EEA Data and Maps
tagline: The European Environment Agency provides comprehensive data and analysis to inform environmental policy and public understanding.
description: The European Environment Agency (EEA) offers a comprehensive portal for environmental analysis and data. It provides access to publications, indicators, interactive maps, country fact sheets, and downloadable datasets. This resource aims to inform policymakers and the public on the status and trends of various environmental topics across Europe.

name: eGRID
tagline: Provides comprehensive data on electric power generation and emissions in the United States.
description: The Emissions & Generation Resource Integrated Database (eGRID) is a comprehensive inventory of environmental attributes for virtually all electric power generated in the United States. It provides detailed data on air emissions, generation, resource mix, and other key attributes for power plants across the nation. This resource supports environmental analysis, policy development, and public understanding of the electric power sector's impact.

name: Electricity Maps
tagline: Track real-time and historical electricity data worldwide, including production mix, CO2 emissions, and prices.
description: Electricity Maps offers an interactive platform for visualizing global electricity data. Users can explore real-time and historical information on energy production mixes, CO2 emissions, and electricity prices across various regions. The tool provides insights into carbon intensity and cross-border electricity flows.

name: EM-Earth
tagline: A comprehensive ensemble meteorological dataset offering global land data for hydrometeorological applications.
description: EM-Earth is an Ensemble Meteorological Dataset for Planet Earth, providing data for precipitation, mean air temperature, air temperature range, and dew-point temperature. It covers global land areas at 0.1° spatial resolution from 1950 to 2019, with both hourly/daily deterministic and daily probabilistic estimates. This dataset is designed to meet diverse requirements for hydrometeorological applications.

name: EnMAP
tagline: Germany's hyperspectral satellite mission for global environmental monitoring and characterization.
description: The Environmental Mapping and Analysis Program (EnMAP) is a German hyperspectral satellite mission. It focuses on monitoring and characterizing Earth's environment globally by measuring geochemical, biochemical, and biophysical variables. The mission provides crucial information on the status and evolution of various terrestrial and aquatic ecosystems.

name: Enviroportal
tagline: A comprehensive web portal for environmental data and mapping tools in Abu Dhabi.
description: Enviroportal offers an interactive web-based platform for exploring environmental data and geospatial information within Abu Dhabi. It provides tools for map search, data search, and various geospatial operations such as measurement, printing, and drawing. The portal also features specialized analytics for key environmental indicators.

name: EOC Geoservice SoilSuite
tagline: This service provides a collection of image data products detailing the spectral and statistical properties of European soils and bare surfaces.
description: The SoilSuite offers a comprehensive collection of image data products focused on European soils and bare surfaces. It leverages DLR's Soil Composite Mapping Processor (ScMAP) to process Sentinel-2 data from 2018-2022, providing insights into spectral and statistical properties at 20m resolution. Products include bare surface reflectance composites, frequency maps, and landcover masks.

name: EODAG
tagline: A unified API and command-line tool for searching, aggregating, and downloading Earth Observation data from various providers.
description: EODAG is a Python framework and command-line tool designed to simplify access to Earth Observation (EO) data. It provides a unified API for searching, aggregating results, and downloading remote sensed images, abstracting away differences between data providers. This tool supports listing collections and searching products by various criteria, facilitating efficient data retrieval.

name: EOxCloudless
tagline: Exploitation-Ready Satellite Imagery for viewing and analysis.
description: EOxCloudless provides high-resolution, cloud-free satellite imagery derived from the ESA Copernicus Sentinel-2 mission. These elaborately post-processed images are optimized for various applications, including web maps and desktop GIS tools. The service offers both prerendered map caches and source mosaics for diverse user needs.

name: EPA Geoportal
tagline: A central hub for accessing, viewing, and understanding environmental spatial data and web mapping services from the EPA Ireland.
description: This geoportal provides comprehensive access to environmental data for Ireland, enabling users to view WebGIS applications, download spatial datasets, and consume Web Mapping Services (WMS). It serves as a central point for discovering and utilizing the Environmental Protection Agency's geospatial information. The platform also offers metadata access and resources to help users learn about the available data.

name: EPSG.io
tagline: A comprehensive online resource for coordinate systems worldwide, offering transformations, map previews, and data formats.
description: EPSG.io provides a vast database of coordinate systems, including EPSG and ESRI codes, allowing users to search, view, and understand various projections. It facilitates coordinate transformations and offers previews of locations on a map. The platform supports common data formats like WKT, OGC GML, and Proj.4 definitions.

name: ESA/CCI viewer
tagline: An online viewer for ESA/CCI Land Cover and conditions project data.
description: This platform provides access to Land Cover and conditions data from the European Space Agency's Climate Change Initiative (ESA CCI) project. Users can explore and download various geospatial products, including land cover maps, plant functional type maps, and surface reflectance composites. The viewer supports data extraction at specific locations and offers yearly classifications spanning decades.

name: ESPON Database Portal
tagline: A portal providing European territorial development and cohesion policy data, indicators, and tools.
description: The ESPON Database Portal offers data, indicators, and tools for European territorial development and cohesion policy. It supports researchers, policymakers, and stakeholders at regional and local levels with information for policy formulation, application, and monitoring.

name: ETH Global Canopy Height 10m 2020 version1
tagline: Global canopy height map for the year 2020 derived from Sentinel-2 and GEDI.
description: This dataset, hosted by the ETH Zurich Research Collection, provides a global canopy height map for 2020. It was created using data from Sentinel-2 and GEDI, offering valuable insights into forest structures and biomass. The resource is open access and available under a Creative Commons license.

name: ETOPO Global Relief Model
tagline: Provides comprehensive global relief data for Earth's land topography and ocean bathymetry.
description: The ETOPO Global Relief Model offers integrated global terrain data, combining land elevation and ocean depth into a single dataset. It is a foundational resource for various earth science applications, research, and mapping projects.

name: European Climate Assessment & Dataset
tagline: Provides data and analysis on changes in European weather and climate extremes.
description: This project offers comprehensive information and daily datasets for monitoring and analyzing changes in weather and climate extremes across Europe. Initiated by ECSN in 1998, it receives financial support from EUMETNET and the European Commission, regularly updating its extensive database with contributions from national meteorological agencies.

name: European Ground Motion Service
tagline: Provides consistent and reliable millimeter-accuracy information on natural and anthropogenic ground motion across Europe.
description: The European Ground Motion Service (EGMS) offers high-precision data on ground movements across Copernicus participating countries. This service leverages space-based remote sensing technology, specifically Synthetic Aperture Radar Interferometry (InSAR) from Sentinel-1, to detect and measure ground motion with millimeter accuracy. The data is updated annually, supporting diverse applications from infrastructure monitoring to urban planning and climate change research.

name: FAO Hand-in-Hand
tagline: The FAO Hand-in-Hand Geospatial Platform provides open-access geographic information and agricultural statistics.
description: The Hand-in-Hand (HiH) Geospatial Platform is an enabling tool for the HiH Initiative, offering over 2 million data layers for targeted, evidence-based interventions. This Digital Public Good provides open-access geographic information, key food security indicators, and agricultural statistics from FAO and external organizations like NGOs, academia, and space agencies.

name: FIAtools
tagline: FIAtools offers an open-source Python ecosystem for comprehensive USDA Forest Service FIA data analysis, from raw plots to growth projections.
description: FIAtools offers an open-source Python ecosystem for USDA Forest Service FIA data analysis. It integrates pyFIA for high-performance survey data querying, gridFIA for spatial raster analysis, and pyFVS for tree growth simulations. An AI-powered interface, askFIA, enables natural language interaction for detailed forest inventory and biomass analysis.

name: Find Environmental Data
tagline: Discover, analyze and download data from Find Environmental Data.
description: This platform allows users to discover, analyze, and download environmental data. It supports various formats like CSV, KML, Zip, GeoJSON, GeoTIFF, and PNG, and provides API links for GeoServices, WMS, and WFS. Users can also analyze data with charts and thematic maps, and create StoryMaps and Web Maps.

name: Finnish Meteorological Institute
tagline: The official manual for accessing Finnish meteorological and oceanographic open data via web services.
description: The Finnish Meteorological Institute publishes a significant portion of its meteorological and oceanographic datasets as Open Data. This documentation serves as a guide for developers to build applications using weather and oceanographic information through the institute's open data web services.

name: FloodPlanet
tagline: A curated dataset of manually labeled inundation data for deep learning applications in flood detection.
description: The FloodPlanet dataset provides manually labeled inundation data, meticulously collected for advancing flood detection research. It serves as a crucial resource for training and validating deep learning models, utilizing high-resolution imagery from PlanetScope, Sentinel-1, and Sentinel-2 satellites. This version 1.0 dataset, contributed by Zhijie(JJ) Zhang and collaborators, is a valuable asset for the geospatial community.

name: Florida DEP Geospatial Open Data
tagline: Florida Department of Environmental Protection's portal for geospatial open data and resources.
description: This platform provides access to a wide array of geospatial open data related to Florida's environmental protection efforts. Users can explore datasets categorized by environmental themes, search for specific projects, and access featured applications and StoryMaps. It serves as a central hub for environmental data maintained by the Florida DEP.

name: Florida Geographic Data Library
tagline: A comprehensive repository for current and archived geospatial data specific to Florida.
description: The Florida Geographic Data Library (FGDL) offers a centralized collection of geospatial data for the state of Florida. It provides users with access to current and archived data through various catalogs and a dedicated explorer. This resource is maintained by the University of Florida GeoPlan Center, supporting a wide range of GIS applications and research needs within the region.

name: Florida Geospatial Open Data Portal
tagline: Explore Florida's Geospatial Open Data Portal
description: This portal provides free access to Florida's geospatial open data, offering a centralized hub for various datasets. Users can download raw data in multiple open formats, including CSV, KML, ESRI Shapefile, and GeoJSON. It also features specialized datasets like the 2025 Statewide Parcel Data and links to agency-specific data portals.

name: FoodTwin
tagline: This tool visualizes global food production and calorie variance across various food categories.
description: FoodTwin offers an interactive platform for exploring global food system data. It provides insights into calorie production variance for diverse food categories, including grains, vegetables, and meat, enabling users to understand regional differences and trends.

name: Forest Canopy Height in Mexican Ecosystems
tagline: A dataset offering lidar and Landsat-derived forest canopy height and vegetation indices for Mexican ecosystems.
description: This dataset combines airborne lidar and Landsat satellite data to map vegetation structure in Mexican ecosystems. It includes lidar-derived canopy height values and Landsat-derived vegetation indices for 499,925 sample points across 1,105 aerial images, enabling fine-resolution ecological restoration monitoring.

name: Forêt ouverte
tagline: Forêt ouverte is a portal for the dissemination of ecoforest data from the Government of Québec.
description: Forêt ouverte serves as the official portal for accessing ecoforest data provided by the Government of Québec. It features an interactive map that enables users to explore a wide array of environmental and forestry information. The platform also offers various tools and resources, including a map catalog, search functionalities, and contact options for support.

name: Foursquare OS Places
tagline: Offers a global platform for location data, points of interest, and developer APIs to power various applications.
description: This portal provides access to Foursquare's extensive database of places, offering rich location intelligence for businesses. It includes detailed information on millions of points of interest, enabling developers to integrate powerful location-based functionalities into their products.

name: Freshwater Ecoregions of the World
tagline: A global biogeographical regionalization of the Earth's freshwater biodiversity.
description: The Freshwater Ecoregions of the World (FEOW) project provides a comprehensive global biogeographical regionalization of Earth's freshwater biodiversity. This resource offers various downloadable files, including GIS shapefiles, Google Earth KMLs, and informational documents, to facilitate research and conservation efforts. It serves as a crucial tool for understanding and mapping global freshwater ecosystems and their unique biodiversity patterns.

name: FWS Wetlands
tagline: A comprehensive resource for U.S. wetland data and conservation information.
description: The U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service (FWS) Wetlands program provides a central repository for geospatial data and information concerning wetland ecosystems across the United States. This vital resource supports critical conservation efforts, environmental planning, and scientific research. It offers accessible resources for understanding wetland status, trends, and values.

name: G-Econ
tagline: A global geophysically based dataset on economic activity at a 1-degree resolution.
description: The G-Econ research project develops a geophysically based global dataset on economic activity. It provides "gross cell product" (GCP) for all regions at a 1-degree longitude by 1-degree latitude resolution. The current dataset, GEcon 4.0, covers 1990, 1995, 2000, and 2005, offering 27,500 terrestrial observations.

name: GADM
tagline: Provides global administrative area maps and spatial data for all countries and their sub-divisions.
description: GADM offers comprehensive geospatial data and maps depicting the administrative divisions of every country worldwide. Users can browse these maps online or download the spatial data to integrate into their own GIS projects and applications. This resource serves as a valuable repository for researchers, mappers, and analysts requiring detailed global administrative boundaries.

name: gagiohome
tagline: Discover, analyze, and download geospatial data for the state of Georgia.
description: This platform serves as a central hub for discovering, analyzing, and downloading geospatial data related to Georgia. Users can access data in various formats like CSV, KML, GeoJSON, GeoTIFF, and PNG, along with API links for GeoServices, WMS, and WFS. It also offers tools for data analysis through charts and thematic maps, and supports the creation of StoryMaps and Web Maps.

name: GEBCO
tagline: GEBCO provides the most authoritative, publicly available bathymetry data sets for the world's oceans.
description: The General Bathymetric Chart of the Oceans (GEBCO) is dedicated to providing the most authoritative, publicly available bathymetry data sets for the world's oceans. This initiative offers a comprehensive range of data products, including gridded bathymetry, undersea feature names, and web services, aiming to facilitate ocean exploration and understanding.

name: GEDI L4A Aboveground Biomass Density
tagline: A dataset providing global footprint-level aboveground biomass density and prediction standard error from NASA's GEDI mission.
description: This dataset offers Global Ecosystem Dynamics Investigation (GEDI) Level 4A Version 2 predictions of aboveground biomass density (AGBD) in Mg/ha and associated standard error estimates. It is derived from lidar waveform relative height metrics, calibrated with field plot data. The data covers the global latitude band observed by the International Space Station (ISS), providing crucial information for ecosystem and land cover studies.

name: geezacoleman/OpenSourceAgriculture
tagline: Collating all open-source datasets, software tools and deployment platforms related to open-source agriculture.
description: This GitHub repository serves as a comprehensive collection point for open-source resources dedicated to agriculture. It aims to centralize access to datasets, software tools, and deployment platforms that support open-source agricultural practices and research. The initiative provides a valuable hub for developers, researchers, and practitioners in the agri-tech community.

name: geo-spatial.org Romania Vector Data
tagline: Provides general vector datasets for Romania, frequently updated and available in various formats and via web services.
description: This page offers general vector datasets for Romania, including administrative boundaries, state frontiers, and localities. Data is frequently updated and accessible in multiple formats like Shapefile, TopoJSON, FlatGeobuf, CSV, and KML. Users can also access the data via WMS/WFS web services or visualize it online through an Open Layers application.

name: geo.admin.ch
tagline: The official geoportal of the Swiss Federal Administration, providing access to geolocated information, data, and services.
description: geo.admin.ch serves as the central platform for all geolocated information, data, and services managed by the Swiss Federal Administration. Public institutions make these resources available, ensuring public access via the internet. It acts as a comprehensive hub for national geospatial data.

name: geo2day
tagline: Download free OpenStreetMap vector data extracts by region in various GIS formats.
description: Geo2day provides free OpenStreetMap (OSM) vector data extracts, organized by continent and country. Users can download pre-processed GIS data in multiple formats like ESRI Shape, GeoPackage, Geodatabase, GeoJSON, PBF, CSV, and TAB. This independent project facilitates access to OSM data for various geospatial applications.

name: geoBoundaries
tagline: An open database of political administrative boundaries.
description: geoBoundaries is an online, open-license resource providing a global database of political administrative boundaries for every country. It tracks approximately 1 million boundaries across over 200 entities, making data available for visualization and download in common file formats. This platform is a collaborative effort by the community and William & Mary geoLab.

name: Geocatmin
tagline: Geocatmin is an agile geographic information system designed for interactive, easy-to-use data access and comprehension.
description: Geocatmin is an agile geographic information system that facilitates interactive and easy access to and comprehension of information. It provides comprehensive geological, mining, and energy data, primarily focusing on Peru but also including global information.

name: GEODATA.gov.gr
tagline: Open data, accessible to all!
description: GEODATA.gov.gr is the official open geospatial data portal for Greece, providing public access to a wide range of spatial datasets. This platform serves as a central hub for discoverable and downloadable geographic information from various Greek government agencies and organizations. It aims to foster transparency and enable data-driven initiatives across different sectors.

name: GeoData@Wisconsin
tagline: GeoData@Wisconsin serves as a central access point for geospatial data related to the state of Wisconsin.
description: GeoData@Wisconsin functions as a comprehensive online repository for geospatial data pertaining to the state of Wisconsin. Users can explore and download a wide variety of datasets, with options for bulk downloads and advanced search functionalities. The platform is a collaborative effort involving the University of Wisconsin and several partner organizations dedicated to geographic information.

name: GeoDiscover Alberta
tagline: A portal for enhanced details and access to Alberta's geospatial data.
description: GeoDiscover Alberta serves as a comprehensive portal for accessing and exploring geospatial data specific to the province of Alberta. It offers tools for searching data, viewing PDF maps, and utilizing an interactive map viewer to combine government and user data. The platform aims to enhance understanding and use of Alberta's geographic information for various purposes.

name: GeoDOT Open Data Portal
tagline: GeoDOT's Open Data Portal provides access to a wide range of Massachusetts transportation and environmental datasets for spatial analysis.
description: This portal offers a comprehensive collection of open datasets from the Massachusetts Department of Transportation (MassDOT). Users can search for and download data in various formats suitable for spatial analysis and web integration. The portal organizes its extensive data into categories and highlights key layers for easy discovery and use.

name: Geofabrik
tagline: Download OpenStreetMap data extracts for self-hosting and data analysis, updated daily.
description: Geofabrik provides free, daily updated OpenStreetMap data extracts for various global regions. Users can download OSM PBF and Shapefiles for self-hosting or data analysis. The service explicitly excludes personal metadata from OSM objects due to EU data protection regulations.

name: Geographic Information Systems Stack Exchange
tagline: Q&A for cartographers, geographers and GIS professionals
description: Geographic Information Systems Stack Exchange is a dedicated Q&A platform for professionals and enthusiasts in cartography, geography, and GIS. It serves as a community-driven resource where users can ask questions, share knowledge, and learn from peers about various aspects of geospatial technology and applications.

name: Geographic Names Server
