tagline: Provides complete, downloadable files of geographic names for geopolitical areas worldwide.
description: This service offers geographic names data in a tab-delimited text format, suitable for GIS, databases, and spreadsheets. Data is available as a single global dataset, broken out by feature classification, or by individual country files. It provides powerful capabilities for data analysis, manipulation, and display for end users.

name: GeoHub
tagline: The Wyoming Geospatial Hub is the primary site for the discovery and delivery of publicly accessible geospatial data in the state of Wyoming.
description: The Wyoming Geospatial Hub serves as the central platform for discovering and accessing publicly available geospatial data across the state of Wyoming. It offers a comprehensive collection of datasets categorized by themes such as administrative boundaries, agriculture, climate, ecology, and infrastructure. This hub is a crucial resource for government agencies, businesses, researchers, and the public seeking geographical information specific to Wyoming.

name: GEOIDEA.RO
tagline: A project improving the scientific basis for open geodata model adoption in Romania.
description: GEOIDEA.RO (GEodata Openness Initative for Development and Economic Advancement in ROmania) is a collaborative project between ETH Zurich and the Technical University of Civil Engineering Bucharest. Launched in January 2013, it aims to enhance the scientific foundations for integrating open geodata models within Romania. The project is co-financed by a grant from Switzerland through the Swiss Contribution to the enlarged European Union.

name: Geological Survey Ireland
tagline: Providing comprehensive geospatial datasets and online viewers for various geological themes in Ireland.
description: Geological Survey Ireland offers a wide array of geospatial datasets and online map viewers covering diverse geological aspects like bedrock, geochemistry, groundwater, marine, and geohazards. Users can access data through online viewers, download zip files, and utilize web services. The data is provided under a Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International license, requiring specific attribution.

name: GeoNet Aotearoa New Zealand Data
tagline: GeoNet provides essential geological hazard information for Aotearoa New Zealand.
description: This dataset contains various data and products recorded by the GeoNet sensor network, crucial for monitoring natural hazards across New Zealand. It includes GNSS, coastal gauge, camera images, waveform, seismic, and time series data, all vital for geological hazard assessment.

name: GeoNOVA
tagline: Find spatial data collections available in Nova Scotia and create your own maps.
description: This service provides access to spatial data collections for Nova Scotia, allowing users to create maps and understand how geographic information aids decision-making. It offers public access to provincial geodata as part of a commitment to improve information access and transparency.

name: Geoportaal van Overijssel
tagline: The official geospatial portal for the Province of Overijssel, offering access to maps, GIS files, and services.
description: This geoportal serves as a central hub for spatial data related to the Province of Overijssel in the Netherlands. It provides users with access to a wide range of maps (PDFs), spatial (GIS) files, and associated services, ensuring data and descriptions are regularly updated. Users can search, browse, view, and download current geospatial datasets directly from the platform.

name: Geoportal ARSO
tagline: The official Slovenian Environmental Agency geoportal providing access to environmental data and thematic maps.
description:
This geoportal serves as a central hub for accessing a wide range of environmental data and interactive maps from the Slovenian Environmental Agency (ARSO). It features updated resources, including an environmental atlas and specialized thematic maps for various monitoring efforts.

Users can explore data related to water quality, soil conditions, and other critical environmental parameters, often presented through interactive dashboards and story maps.

name: Geoportal.de
tagline: Germany's national geospatial portal for official geodata and interactive mapping tools.
description: This official German government portal offers a centralized platform for discovering and utilizing geospatial information from various federal and state authorities. It provides interactive map views, diverse base layers, and advanced tools for data analysis and visualization. Users can explore a wide range of topics and integrate their own WMS services.

name: Geoportale MASE
tagline: National access point for environmental and territorial information in Italy.
description: This national geoportale, managed by the Italian Ministry of Environment and Energy Security (MASE), serves as a central hub for geospatial environmental data. It offers tools for searching metadata, visualizing cartography, and building custom maps using OGC-compliant services.

name: Georgia GIS Data Clearinghouse
tagline: A central repository for geospatial data pertaining to the state of Georgia.
description: This platform serves as the official Georgia GIS Data Clearinghouse, providing a centralized access point for various geospatial datasets relevant to the state. Users are required to register for an account to access the comprehensive data search page and download available resources.

name: Georgia GIS Data Clearinghouse
tagline: Provides a central online repository for geospatial data specific to the state of Georgia.
description: The Georgia GIS Data Clearinghouse serves as a crucial online portal for users seeking geographic information system data relevant to the state. It facilitates access to a wide array of datasets, supporting various applications and analyses across different sectors within Georgia.

name: GeoSeer
tagline: The spatial data search engine for WMS, WFS, WCS, and WMTS datasets.
description: GeoSeer functions as a dedicated search engine for spatial web services. It enables users to discover over 3.5 million distinct spatial GIS datasets, including WMS, WFS, WCS, and WMTS, hosted across more than 400,000 live services globally. This tool provides advanced search capabilities, allowing users to find specific data by location, service type, or projection.

name: Get Information about Schools
tagline: Find, search, and download information about schools, establishment groups, and governance roles in England.
description: This service provides a centralized platform for accessing and searching public data related to educational establishments, groups, and governance within England. Users can find detailed information, search for specific entities, and download daily updated datasets for analysis. It serves as a key resource for understanding the structure and performance of the UK education system.

name: GIS and Digital Spatial Data Research Guide
tagline: A comprehensive guide to California-specific GIS data and spatial resources.
description: This research guide provides a curated list of resources for geospatial data focusing on California. It includes links to state-level data portals, specific agency datasets, and university data repositories, serving as a central hub for researchers and the public to discover and access relevant spatial information.

name: GIS Program at NCAR
tagline: Advancing actionable Earth system science with Geographic Information Systems and data visualization.
description: The GIS Program at NCAR focuses on applying geospatial technologies to address critical Earth system science challenges, particularly those related to climate change. It develops and provides interactive data visualization tools that help users explore climate anomalies, variability, and future scenarios. This initiative aims to enhance the understanding and communication of complex environmental data.

name: GISOost
tagline: Access digital maps and geospatial data for various themes in Oost-Vlaanderen, Belgium.
description: GISOost provides a central hub for digital maps and geospatial data related to Oost-Vlaanderen, Belgium. Users can explore various themes through interactive geolokets or integrate data directly into their own GIS applications using provided web services. This platform supports diverse applications from environmental planning to mobility analysis.

name: GISsurfer
tagline: An accessible online tool for exploring GIS data and creating custom interactive maps without specialized software.
description: GISsurfer provides a public service for anyone to easily explore GIS data from various sources, including federal to local levels. It offers a wide array of basemaps, supports custom map link creation, and allows for the generation of georeferenced images. The platform is designed for intuitive use across both mobile and desktop devices.

name: GLCNMO Land Cover Data
tagline: Global Land Cover data in raster format, classifying the entire globe into 20 categories based on FAO's LCCS.
description: The Global Land Cover by National Mapping Organizations (GLCNMO) provides geospatial land cover information in raster format, classifying the entire globe into 20 categories based on FAO's LCCS. Developed through international collaboration, it offers three versions (2003, 2008, 2013) using MODIS data, allowing for comparisons and integration with other LCCS-based products.

name: GLiM - Global Lithological Map
tagline: A global dataset providing detailed lithological information for Earth's land surface.
description: GLiM is a comprehensive global lithological map project developed by the University of Hamburg. This dataset offers detailed information on the composition of Earth's land surface, serving as a fundamental resource for various geological and environmental studies. It is primarily used for research in areas such as aquatic geochemistry and broader Earth sciences.

name: Global 1-km Consensus Land Cover
tagline: A global 1-km consensus land-cover product for biodiversity and ecosystem modeling.
description: This resource provides global, remote-sensing supported environmental layers at 1-km resolution for assessing status and trends in biodiversity, ecosystems, and climate. It offers two versions of consensus land-cover datasets, integrating multiple satellite products.

name: Global 30m Height Above Nearest Drainage (HAND)
tagline: A global 30m resolution terrain model providing height above nearest drainage for near-worldwide land coverage.
description: The Global 30m Height Above Nearest Drainage (HAND) dataset offers near-worldwide land coverage at 30-meter resolution. It is a terrain model that normalizes topography to relative heights along drainage networks, indicating local drainage potentials. Produced from the Copernicus GLO-30 Public DEM, each pixel value represents the vertical distance to the nearest drainage.

name: Global Forest Change
tagline: Download global forest extent and change data derived from Landsat images for 2000-2014.
description: This resource provides access to version 1.2 of the Global Forest Change dataset, offering detailed information on forest extent and loss from 2000 through 2014. The data is derived from time-series analysis of Landsat imagery, with updates incorporating Landsat 8 OLI for more recent years. Users can download the dataset and are encouraged to register for updates.

name: Global Lakes and Wetlands Database
tagline: WWF and the Center for Environmental Systems Research, University of Kassel, Germany created the Global Lakes and Wetlands Database (GLWD).
description: The Global Lakes and Wetlands Database (GLWD) was developed by WWF and the Center for Environmental Systems Research, University of Kassel, Germany. This database provides comprehensive geospatial information on lakes and wetlands worldwide, crucial for environmental research and conservation efforts. It serves as a vital resource for understanding global aquatic ecosystems and their distribution.

name: Global Renewables Watch
tagline: A global, temporal dataset tracking solar and wind energy installations using satellite imagery and deep learning.
description: This initiative provides a comprehensive global dataset of commercial solar photovoltaic farms and onshore wind turbines. It utilizes deep learning models applied to high-resolution satellite imagery, analyzed quarterly from 2017 to 2024, to identify installations and estimate their construction dates and preceding land use.

name: Global Seismic Hazard Map
tagline: Provides a global overview of seismic hazard, mapping data from the Global Seismic Hazard Program.
description: This website presents the Global Seismic Hazard Map, an initiative focused on assessing and visualizing earthquake risks worldwide. It compiles and displays data from the Global Seismic Hazard Program, offering insights into potential ground shaking due to seismic activity across various regions. The platform serves as a vital resource for understanding geological hazards.

name: GlobCover Portal
tagline: Provides global land cover maps derived from ENVISAT MERIS sensor data for environmental monitoring.
description: The GlobCover Portal offers global land cover maps and composites, a result of an ESA initiative with partners like JRC, EEA, and FAO. It utilizes observations from the 300m MERIS sensor on board the ENVISAT satellite mission to deliver land cover products for specific periods, including 2004-2006 and 2009.

name: GloVis
tagline: Query and order satellite images, aerial photographs, and cartographic products through the U.S. Geological Survey.
description: GloVis is the USGS Global Visualization Viewer, providing access to remote sensing data since 2001. Redesigned in 2017, this platform allows users to instantly view and download scenes of satellite imagery and aerial photographs. It offers tools for filtering results, viewing multiple scenes over time, and customizing the user experience.

name: GMRT
tagline: Global Multi-Resolution Topography Data Synthesis provides a continually updated, harmonized global elevation dataset.
description: The Global Multi-Resolution Topography (GMRT) synthesis is a unique and continually updated global elevation dataset. It integrates and harmonizes cleaned multibeam sonar data from oceans worldwide, rigorously reviewed and processed by the GMRT Team. This foundational resource offers seamless access to high-quality elevation data for ocean and terrestrial geoscientific research.

name: GOES Imagery Viewer
tagline: Explore real-time and archived imagery from NOAA's GOES-East and GOES-West satellites.
description: This platform provides a comprehensive viewer for Geostationary Operational Environmental Satellite (GOES) imagery, offering various channels and RGB composites. Users can access data for regions like the Continental U.S. (CONUS) to monitor weather phenomena and environmental conditions. The site supports real-time updates and historical data viewing for meteorological and climate applications.

name: Google Maps Scraper
tagline: This tool extracts comprehensive business data from Google Maps for lead generation, competitor analysis, and market research.
description: The Google Maps Scraper extracts detailed business information from Google Maps, including addresses, contact details, reviews, and pricing. It supports lead generation, competitor tracking, and market analysis by providing structured data for thousands of locations. Users can export data, integrate with other tools, and automate research workflows.

name: Google Satellite Embedding V1
tagline: A comprehensive dataset of annual satellite embeddings, provided as Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFF (COG) files.
description: This dataset offers annual satellite embeddings for the years 2018 to 2024, inclusive. Produced by Google and Google DeepMind, it provides valuable earth observation data in an easily accessible format. It is ideal for machine learning applications and environmental analysis.

name: Great Lakes Bathymetry
tagline: A collection of Great Lakes bathymetry and topographic maps compiled from over a century of soundings.
description: This collection compiles over a century of lake floor geological and geophysical data for public use. It includes bathymetry and detailed topographic maps for each Great Lake, derived from soundings collected by various U.S. and Canadian organizations. The data serves as a vital resource for researchers and communities addressing Great Lakes science, pollution, and ecosystem health.

name: gridMET
tagline: A high-spatial resolution dataset of daily surface meteorological data for the contiguous US and southern British Columbia.
description: gridMET is a high-spatial resolution (~4-km) dataset providing daily surface meteorological data across the contiguous US from 1979-yesterday, with real-time extensions to southern British Columbia. It offers critical inputs for ecological, agricultural, and hydrological models, updated daily. The dataset includes primary climate variables and derived products like reference evapotranspiration and drought indices.

name: Guam CMSP Data Portal
tagline: A comprehensive GIS data portal providing geospatial information for Guam's Coastal and Marine Spatial Planning.
description: This portal offers a centralized access point for various GIS datasets pertaining to Guam's coastal and marine environment. Users can view data screenshots, examine detailed metadata, and directly download datasets, supporting Coastal and Marine Spatial Planning (CMSP) initiatives. It also features interactive mapping interfaces for select data layers.

name: GéoGratis
tagline: Search, discover, and download free maps, data, imagery, and publications from Canada.
description: GéoGratis is a platform provided by Natural Resources Canada, offering public access to a wide range of geospatial information. Users can explore and acquire various free geographic products including maps, satellite imagery, and cartographic data for diverse applications. It serves as a central repository for Canadian geospatial resources.

name: Halifax Regional Municipality
tagline: Halifax Regional Municipality provides public access to its open geospatial data and analytics.
description: The Halifax Regional Municipality Open Data portal offers public access to a wide range of geospatial data. It is committed to improving citizen engagement and transparency by providing data free of charge in machine-readable formats. Users can explore various categories and access recently released and updated datasets.

name: Harmonized world soil database v1.2
tagline: A comprehensive global soil database providing harmonized soil information for diverse applications.
description: The Harmonized World Soil Database (HWSD) v1.2 is a 30 arc-second raster database developed through a collaboration between FAO and IIASA. It integrates existing regional and national soil information with the FAO-UNESCO Soil Map of the World, offering consistent soil data on a global scale. This resource is vital for environmental modeling and agricultural planning.

name: Harris Central Appraisal District
tagline: Provides property appraisal, tax information, and geospatial data for Harris County, Texas.
description: The Harris Central Appraisal District offers a comprehensive platform for property search, appraisal data, and tax information within Harris County, Texas. It provides access to various online services, including interactive maps and public data resources.

name: Harvard Dataverse
tagline: Access to this research data repository is currently restricted.
description: This Harvard Dataverse instance is a platform for sharing research data, but access to the requested page is currently forbidden. It typically hosts a wide range of datasets for academic and research purposes across various disciplines.

name: Hawaii Statewide GIS Program
tagline: The Hawaii Statewide GIS Program offers an open data site for geospatial information.
description: This geoportal serves as the official open data site for the Hawaii Statewide GIS Program, providing centralized access to a diverse collection of geospatial datasets for the state. It allows users to explore, visualize, and download data related to various aspects of Hawaii's environment, infrastructure, and demographics.

name: HELCOM Map and Data Service
tagline: An online platform offering open access to geographic and environmental data for the Baltic Sea region.
description: The HELCOM Map and data service (HELCOM MADS) provides open access to a wide range of geographic and environmental data for the Baltic Sea. Users can view datasets on bathymetry, biodiversity, marine protected areas, shipping traffic, and more as interactive map layers. It serves as a central hub for environmental information in the region.

name: Helsinki Region Infoshare
tagline: A service providing open data and applications for the Helsinki metropolitan area.
description: Helsinki Region Infoshare (HRI) is a collaborative platform offering open data from the Helsinki metropolitan area. It serves as a central hub for various datasets, news, and user-developed applications related to urban development, environment, and traffic. The platform aims to make public data accessible and usable for developers, researchers, and citizens.

name: HighMountainAsia
tagline: This collection provides remote sensing data and tools for monitoring snow and ice changes across the High Mountain Asia region.
description: The NSIDC DAAC High Mountain Asia (HMA) collection offers comprehensive data on snow and ice dynamics across five major mountain ranges, including the Himalaya and Hindu Kush. It integrates historical and modern remote sensing techniques to monitor glacial changes, water resources, and related hazards. The Glacier and Snow Melt Toolbox (GMELT) provides various remote sensing products and models for assessing environmental shifts.

name: Historical Hurricane Tracks
tagline: Explore and analyze over 13,000 historical hurricane tracks and detailed storm information from NOAA.
description: This comprehensive NOAA resource provides access to historical hurricane tracks, offering detailed data on over 13,000 storms. Users can search by location, storm name, year, or ocean basin and filter results by storm category, pressure, and date range. It serves as a valuable tool for researching past hurricane events and their impacts.

name: historical-basemaps
tagline: A collection of georeferenced historical boundaries for world countries and cultural regions.
description: This open-source project provides ready-to-use basemaps for mapping historical data on global or continental scales. The datasets consist of georeferenced boundaries of past political entities, primarily for academic and research applications. Users are encouraged to verify the data against other sources due to its work-in-progress nature.

name: Humanitarian Data Exchange
tagline: A platform for sharing humanitarian data worldwide, supporting effective crisis response.
description: The Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX) is an open data platform managed by OCHA that aims to make humanitarian data easy to find and use. It provides a central location for data related to humanitarian crises, allowing users to access datasets on various topics from different organizations for informed decision-making.

name: HydroSHEDS
tagline: Seamless hydrographic data for global and regional applications, freely available in standard GIS formats.
description: The HydroSHEDS database offers a suite of freely available global digital data layers supporting hydro-ecological research and applications worldwide. Its hydrographic data products encompass catchment boundaries, river networks, and lakes at multiple resolutions and scales, forming a geospatial framework for diverse assessments.

name: IBGE
tagline: Official Brazilian institute for geographical, cartographical, geodetic, and statistical information.
description: The Brazilian Institute of Geography and Statistics (IBGE) is the primary provider of statistical, geographical, cartographical, and environmental information in Brazil. It conducts censuses and surveys, offering a vast array of data crucial for public planning, government, and academic research. The institute's work covers demographics, economy, natural resources, and socio-economic indicators across the national territory.

name: Idaho DEQ GIS Open Data
tagline: A central hub for Idaho Department of Environmental Quality's GIS open data and mapping applications.
description: This platform serves as the Idaho Department of Environmental Quality's (DEQ) GIS Open Data HUB, providing public access to a wide range of environmental geographic information. It features data and applications focused on protecting human health and the quality of Idaho’s air, land, and water.

name: IEM
tagline: Iowa State University's Iowa Environmental Mesonet provides GIS resources for spatially referenced environmental data.
description: The Iowa Environmental Mesonet (IEM) offers a comprehensive GIS Mainpage from Iowa State University. It provides tools, documentation, and web applications for integrating and manipulating spatially referenced environmental datasets. This platform serves as a central hub for GIS-related information and resources pertaining to IEM data.

name: IFMHA
tagline: A comprehensive dataset of fluvial hydraulic and geometry attributes from USGS streamflow measurements across the US.
description: IFMHA is a large dataset containing over 2.8 million field measurements of fluvial hydraulic and geometry attributes. Collected from 10,050 USGS gage sites across the United States, the data spans from 1845 to 2022 and extends the HYDRoSWOT dataset with additional attributes from NHDPlusV21.

name: Illinois Department of Transportation
tagline: Discover, analyze, and download geospatial data from the Illinois Department of Transportation.
description: This platform provides access to geospatial data from the Illinois Department of Transportation. Users can discover, analyze, and download data in various formats like CSV, KML, GeoJSON, and GeoTIFF, and utilize API links for GeoServices, WMS, and WFS. It also supports building and exploring applications, charts, and thematic maps.

name: Illinois State Geological Survey Clearinghouse
tagline: A data clearinghouse providing access to geospatial data for Illinois, covering climate, coastal, and more.
description: This website serves as a data clearinghouse for the Illinois State Geological Survey (ISGS). It offers a wide array of geospatial datasets, focusing on environmental and geological topics specific to Illinois. Users can find data related to climate, coastal areas, hydrology, and various other earth science domains.

name: Indiana Geographic Information Office
tagline: Facilitating GIS collaboration and promoting geospatial information use across Indiana.
description: The Indiana Geographic Information Office (IGIO) is a government entity responsible for governing GIS activities and fostering a cooperative geospatial community within the state. It works in conjunction with the Indiana Geographic Information Council, a non-profit organization, to advance GIS projects and initiatives that benefit Hoosiers.

name: Indiana Spatial Data Portal
tagline: Provides public access to Indiana geospatial data, including orthophotos and lidar imagery, with no use restrictions.
description: The Indiana Spatial Data Portal (ISDP) offers public access to a wide range of Indiana geospatial data, supported by Indiana University's high-performance infrastructure. It archives and provides web access to imagery from state and local government initiatives, including statewide orthophotos and lidar imagery managed by the Indiana Geographic Information Office. All datasets are available for download without use restrictions.

name: Indiana Statewide Digital Aerial Imagery Catalog
tagline: A comprehensive catalog of Indiana's statewide digital aerial imagery, available in various formats including Cloud Optimized GeoTIFFs.
description: This catalog provides access to the State of Indiana's digital orthophotography, managed by the Indiana Geographic Information Office and IOT Office of Technology. Imagery dates back to 2005 and is available in formats like Cloud Optimized GeoTIFF (COG), original GeoTIFF, ECW, and MrSID. The datasets are organized into a statewide tile grid scheme, with collections updated on a 4-year cycle and licensed under Creative Commons 0 (CC0).

name: IndianaMap
tagline: IndianaMap centralizes various GIS data for the state of Indiana, serving as its geospatial open data portal.
description: IndianaMap is the official geospatial open data portal for the state of Indiana, providing centralized access to a wide range of GIS data. Users can explore data through the IndianaMap Viewer, custom map applications, or download datasets directly from the Hub. The platform aims to make Indiana's geospatial information readily available for various applications and analyses.

name: International Permafrost Association
tagline: Global hub for permafrost research, data, and scientific collaboration.
description: The International Permafrost Association (IPA) serves as a leading international organization dedicated to fostering permafrost research and disseminating critical information. It provides a centralized platform for accessing diverse data resources, publications, and educational materials related to permafrost science.

name: io-biodiversity
tagline: This dataset provides comprehensive biodiversity information, accessible through the Microsoft Planetary Computer for environmental analysis.
description: The io-biodiversity dataset offers a rich collection of geospatial data focused on biodiversity. Hosted on the Microsoft Planetary Computer, it facilitates large-scale environmental research and conservation efforts by providing readily available and analysis-ready data.

name: Iowa DOT Open Data
tagline: The Iowa Department of Transportation's public platform for exploring and downloading open geospatial data.
description: This site serves as the Iowa Department of Transportation's public platform, offering easy access to explore and download open geospatial data. It provides critical information on managing the state’s transportation infrastructure, aiming to improve public experience and maximize system performance.

name: Iowa Geospatial Data Clearinghouse
tagline: State of Iowa Geospatial Data Clearinghouse providing framework data access and curated services.
description: The Iowa Geospatial Data Clearinghouse offers public geospatial data, tools, and resources from the State of Iowa and its partners. It provides access to foundational data and curated services, supporting statewide data initiatives and information sharing.

name: IPUMS NHGIS
tagline: Provides U.S. census and other historical geographic data for research and analysis.
description: The National Historical Geographic Information System (NHGIS) offers a vast collection of U.S. census data and boundary files from 1790 to the present. It enables researchers to track social, economic, and environmental change over time through consistent geographic units.

name: Istat
tagline: Official definitive territorial bases and census variables for Italy.
description: This resource from Istat (Italian National Institute of Statistics) provides definitive territorial bases and census variables for 2021. It offers essential geospatial and statistical data for various analytical purposes.

name: ISW Map Room
tagline: Provides a vast collection of open-source conflict maps for detailed analysis of global conflicts.
description: The ISW Map Room offers an extensive collection of interactive and static maps, providing in-depth visual analysis of global conflicts. Users can explore maps by team, region, map series, and product line, facilitating detailed research into ongoing geopolitical events.

name: IUCN Red List
tagline: Access global spatial data and distribution maps for threatened species and taxonomic groups.
description: The IUCN Red List provides spatial data for over 152,300 species, representing 88% of its global assessments. These datasets include distribution maps for comprehensively assessed taxonomic groups and selected freshwater species, offering crucial information on species' conservation status.

name: Japan Prefectures, 3D Point Cloud Data
tagline: This dataset offers high-precision 3D point cloud data covering all prefectures across Japan.
description: This dataset provides high-precision 3D point cloud data for all prefectures throughout Japan. It is generated from aerial laser surveys, airborne laser bathymetry, and mobile mapping systems, intended for infrastructure maintenance, disaster prevention, and autonomous vehicle applications.

name: JAXA Land Surface Temperature
tagline: JAXA provides land surface temperature data from the Global Change Observation Mission - Climate “SHIKISAI” satellite.
description: This JAXA Earth-graphy page offers access to land surface temperature data collected by the Global Change Observation Mission - Climate "SHIKISAI" satellite. The data is made available for various applications, contributing to climate research and environmental monitoring.

name: Jing Wei
tagline: Provides high-resolution, long-term global and China-specific datasets for ground-level air pollutants using artificial intelligence.
description: This website offers the GlobalHighAirPollutants (GHAP) and ChinaHighAirPollutants (CHAP) datasets, featuring long-term, full-coverage, and high-resolution data for various air pollutants. These datasets are generated using advanced artificial intelligence techniques on big data, considering the spatiotemporal heterogeneity of air pollution.

name: Kansas Geoportal
tagline: The Kansas Geoportal Hub for sharing geospatial data across state departments.
description: This platform serves as a central hub for sharing a wide array of geospatial data across various state departments in Kansas. It provides a comprehensive GIS Data Catalog, allowing users to explore and access diverse datasets. The geoportal aims to facilitate data discovery and utilization for state-level initiatives and public access.

name: Kansas Historical Society Maps
tagline: This collection offers extensive historical maps, atlases, and architectural drawings detailing Kansas, the Great Plains, and global regions.
description: The Kansas Historical Society maintains a significant collection of over 25,000 maps, atlases, and architectural drawings. These resources illustrate changes in terrain, infrastructure, property, and boundaries across Kansas, the United States, and the world, with particular strength in 19th-century Kansas.

name: Kartat.kapsi.fi
tagline: A download service for open map data from the National Land Survey of Finland.
description: This service provides open geospatial datasets from the National Land Survey of Finland, including base maps, background maps, orthophotos, and control point registers. Users can download various data types via HTTP, FTP, and rsync, supporting access to essential Finnish geographic information.

name: KITTI Vision Benchmark Suite
tagline: Provides real-world computer vision benchmarks and datasets for autonomous driving research.
description: The KITTI Vision Benchmark Suite offers challenging real-world datasets for computer vision tasks in autonomous driving. Data is collected using a research vehicle equipped with high-resolution cameras, a Velodyne laser scanner, and a GPS system in various environments around Karlsruhe, Germany. It provides benchmarks for tasks like stereo, optical flow, visual odometry, 3D object detection, and 3D tracking.

name: Knowledge Hub for Water
tagline: Providing scientific evidence and data tools to support EU water policy and its integration with sectoral policies.
description: This hub offers scientific evidence and data tools developed through Joint Research Centre (JRC) projects. Its primary goal is to support European Union water policy, integrating it with related sectors like agriculture, energy, and climate. The focus is on environmental and health protection, aligning with EU Green Deal strategies.

name: KyFromAbove on AWS
tagline: Provides public domain aerial imagery and LiDAR data for Kentucky, hosted on AWS.
description: The KyFromAbove initiative offers a current basemap for Kentucky, including leaf-off aerial photography and LiDAR data. This resource supports state, federal, local, and regional users by providing open data to reduce GIS application development costs and promote data sharing. All data is made publicly available.

name: KyGovMaps Open Data Portal
tagline: Explore, access, and download Kentucky-specific GIS data and discover mapping applications.
description: The KyGovMaps Open Data Portal provides a centralized hub for Kentucky-specific GIS data. Users can explore, access, and download various datasets, analyze them with maps, and discover web mapping applications. It also offers direct access to mapping services via REST endpoints for integration into new applications.

name: Land Processes Distributed Active Archive Center
tagline: Provides crucial Earth science data for investigating and monitoring land processes.
description: NASA's Land Processes Distributed Active Archive Center (LP DAAC) offers a vast array of Earth science data. This center is essential for researchers and scientists investigating, characterizing, and monitoring biological, geological, hydrological, and ecological conditions and processes. It serves as a key resource within the NASA Earthdata ecosystem for land science.

name: Land Records
tagline: Provides accessible, authoritative land parcel data for the United States at competitive prices.
description: Land Records offers a comprehensive nationwide land parcel dataset, covering 99% of the United States. This service provides a rich set of land, building, and ownership attributes, available for instant download in multiple formats. It caters to various projects, from individual researchers to large organizations.

name: LGB
tagline: Official provider of geoinformation and surveying services for the state of Brandenburg, Germany.
description: LGB (Landesvermessung und Geobasisinformation Brandenburg) serves as the state agency responsible for official land surveying and providing fundamental geoinformation for Brandenburg, Germany. It offers a wide array of geospatial data, applications, and services to the public and professional users.

name: LiDAR and Aerial Archaeology
tagline: Free LiDAR & aerial photography maps from around the world, alongside other related archaeological resources.
description: LiDAR and Aerial Archaeology offers free LiDAR and aerial photography maps from various global regions. It also provides access to other related archaeological resources, including training materials and geological data.

name: LILA BC
tagline: A comprehensive platform offering extensive labeled datasets of wildlife imagery for machine learning and computer vision research.
description: LILA BC provides a curated collection of publicly available datasets, primarily consisting of camera trap and underwater video imagery. These datasets support the development and training of machine learning models for wildlife monitoring, biodiversity analysis, and environmental impact studies. The platform aggregates data from various conservation projects and agencies worldwide.

name: LILA BC
tagline: A curated list of conservation-related labeled datasets not hosted on LILA.
description: LILA BC provides a comprehensive list of conservation-related labeled datasets that are not directly hosted on the LILA platform. This resource complements LILA's own dataset collection, aiming to track machine-learning-ready data with interesting labels attached to images or documents. The page emphasizes publicly accessible datasets relevant to various conservation efforts.

name: LINZ Data Service
tagline: New Zealand's authoritative source for geospatial data and services.
description: This platform serves as the official data service for Land Information New Zealand (LINZ), providing access to a wide range of geospatial data. It offers various datasets for download and through APIs, supporting diverse applications across government, industry, and the public.

name: LOKSTAT
tagline: A historical database providing access to Belgian census data from the late 19th and early 20th centuries.
description: LOKSTAT is an historical databank of local statistics, offering results from general censuses conducted in Belgium around 1900. It provides consultative access to data from every Belgian municipality existing during that period, including industry, agriculture, and population statistics. This resource is part of the Queteletcentrum at Ghent University.

name: London Data
tagline: The official open data portal for the Greater London Authority.
description: This portal provides access to a wide range of public datasets related to London, covering various aspects of the city's operations and demographics. It serves as a central hub for researchers, developers, and citizens to explore and utilize data for analysis, applications, and informed decision-making within the capital.

name: Louisiana DOTD
tagline: Discover, analyze, and download geospatial data from the Louisiana Department of Transportation & Development.
description: This platform provides access to geospatial data from the Louisiana Department of Transportation & Development. Users can discover, analyze, and download various datasets in formats like CSV, KML, GeoJSON, and GeoTIFF. It also offers API links for GeoServices, WMS, and WFS, enabling further analysis with charts and maps.

name: Louisiana GIS Atlas
tagline: Providing public access to high-resolution geospatial data for Louisiana and surrounding coastal areas.
description: Atlas, hosted by LSU, serves as a central repository for high-resolution geospatial data pertaining primarily to Louisiana. It offers public access to crucial datasets like statewide Lidar elevation data, providing the first comprehensive lidar coverage for the state. Additionally, the platform hosts historical aerial imagery from sources such as GOHSEP and coastal DOQQ imagery spanning Louisiana, Mississippi, and Alabama, making valuable environmental and land-use data readily available.

name: LRIS Portal
tagline: A comprehensive portal for New Zealand's land resource and environmental data.
description: The LRIS Portal provides access to a vast collection of national and regional land resource information for New Zealand. It serves as a central hub for researchers, policymakers, and the public to explore and download critical environmental datasets. The portal facilitates informed decision-making across various sectors.

name: Maine GeoLibrary
tagline: A centralized geospatial data hub for the state of Maine, built using ArcGIS Hub.
description: This website serves as the new Maine GeoLibrary, providing access to essential geospatial data for the state. It offers a structured collection of GIS framework layers, facilitating discovery and access to critical geographic information for various applications. The platform leverages ArcGIS Hub technology to organize and disseminate spatial data efficiently.

name: Maine Geological Survey Open Data
tagline: A hub for accessing geological and environmental data from the Maine Geological Survey.
description: This platform serves as the official open data portal for the Maine Geological Survey, offering a centralized resource for researchers, professionals, and the public. Users can explore and download a wide array of geospatial datasets related to Maine's geology and environment. The portal provides access to data organized by categories such as bedrock, surficial geology, hydrogeology, and coastal features.

name: Major-TOM: Expandable Datasets for Earth Observation
tagline: A standard for curating, sharing, and combining large-scale Earth Observation datasets for AI and ML.
description: This platform offers a framework for building extensive, open, and compatible Earth observation datasets. It hosts a variety of image and embedding datasets, including multi-spectral Sentinel-2, SAR Sentinel-1, and Copernicus DEM, designed to support deep learning models.

name: Malaria Atlas Project
tagline: Provides interactive maps and data for understanding global malaria prevalence and intervention strategies.
description: The Malaria Atlas Project (MAP) offers a comprehensive platform for visualizing and accessing geospatial data on malaria. It features interactive maps displaying global Pf Parasite Rate, intervention coverage, and commodity distribution across various years. This resource supports research and public health efforts by providing detailed insights into malaria epidemiology.

name: MapasIGME
tagline: A vital portal for geological and thematic cartography in Spain, supporting scientific, technical, and socioeconomic activities.
description: This platform provides essential cartographic knowledge from the Geological and Mining Institute of Spain (IGME). It serves as a foundational resource for scientific, technical, and socioeconomic activities directly impacting the physical environment and natural resources. The data supports research and decision-making related to natural resource management, public works, agriculture, land use, territorial planning, environment, and natural hazards.

name: Mapping Sound - NPS
tagline: Explore and understand the preservation and measurement of natural soundscapes within U.S. National Parks.
description: This initiative by the U.S. National Park Service focuses on the importance of natural sounds, their preservation, and the impacts of noise pollution. It provides comprehensive information on exploring, understanding, and measuring soundscapes in national parks. The program highlights educational resources and efforts to improve sound environments for wildlife, wilderness, visitors, and cultural-historical sites.

name: MappingGM
tagline: A geospatial platform for exploring and understanding Greater Manchester's geography.
description: MappingGM serves as a dedicated geospatial and GIS platform focused on the Greater Manchester region in the United Kingdom. It provides tools and potentially data to visualize and analyze geographical information relevant to the area, supporting various applications from urban planning to environmental monitoring.

name: MappingSupport GIS Servers List
tagline: A comprehensive directory of federal, state, county, and city GIS servers for public data access.
description: This resource compiles a detailed list of GIS servers from various government levels, including federal, state, county, and city entities. It serves as a valuable reference for users seeking access to publicly available geospatial data and services.

name: Maps & GIS of Costa Rica
tagline: A research guide from Texas A&M University Libraries for geospatial resources related to Costa Rica.
description: This is a specialized research guide provided by Texas A&M University Libraries. It curates information and resources on maps and Geographic Information Systems (GIS) specifically focused on Costa Rica, serving students and researchers. The guide aims to facilitate access to relevant geospatial data and tools for academic and research purposes.

name: MAPSTER
tagline: Provides a digital collection of archival maps of Poland and Central Europe for non-commercial use.
description: MAPSTER offers a comprehensive digital collection of archival maps focusing on Poland and Central Europe, available for non-commercial purposes. It features a robust locality search engine to quickly find maps for specific places, a graphic index browser for navigating map sheets, and tabular summaries detailing map attributes like publication year and resolution.

name: Marine Regions
tagline: A standard list of marine georeferenced place names and areas.
description: Marine Regions provides a standardized list of marine georeferenced place names and areas, integrating information from the VLIMAR Gazetteer and MARBOUND database. It serves as a global standard for marine geographic locations, boundaries, and regions, offering comprehensive statistics on marine places and names.

name: Maryland Open Data Portal
tagline: Quickly search for the latest data and content from Maryland contributors.
description: The Maryland Open Data Portal serves as a centralized hub for accessing public data and content from various state and local contributors across Maryland. It provides a platform for users to quickly search, discover, and utilize datasets for analysis and application development. The portal aims to foster transparency and collaboration by making governmental information readily available.

name: Maryland's GIS Data Catalog
tagline: Quickly search for the latest data and geographic content from Maryland contributors.
description: This is Maryland's official GIS Data Catalog, providing a centralized hub for open, transparent, and easily accessible geographic content from various state contributors. It aims to make data discoverable and usable for the public, supporting various applications and analyses.

name: MassGIS
tagline: Access a wide variety of geospatial data layers for Massachusetts.
description: MassGIS is the official source for geospatial data from the Commonwealth of Massachusetts. It provides diverse GIS data layers designed for use in various software and web map applications by the public and professionals alike.

name: MassGIS Data Layers
tagline: A comprehensive collection of digital geospatial data layers for the Commonwealth of Massachusetts.
description: MassGIS provides a central repository for various digital geospatial datasets pertaining to Massachusetts. Each dataset offers detailed descriptions, metadata, and direct links for free data downloads, supporting diverse applications and research needs across the state.

name: MDOT GIS Open Data
tagline: Provides public access to geospatial data from the Michigan Department of Transportation.
description: This service offers a public portal for downloading geospatial data from the Michigan Department of Transportation (MDOT). It serves as a valuable resource for citizens and state employees, providing diverse datasets related to transportation infrastructure and public services. Users should be aware of the terms of use and data disclaimers regarding accuracy and completeness.

name: MDOT GIS Open Data
tagline: Supporting the implementation and use of GIS for informed decisions about Michigan's transportation infrastructure.
description: The Michigan Department of Transportation (MDOT) leverages its Geographic Information System (GIS) to address spatial challenges and enhance decision-making related to the state's transportation network. This initiative provides innovative solutions to support more informed choices about Michigan's vital infrastructure.

name: MDOT GIS Open Data Portal
tagline: Maryland's Department of Transportation provides open data and interactive mapping applications for public use.
description: The MDOT GIS Open Data Portal serves as a central hub for geospatial content from Maryland's Department of Transportation and the entire State. It offers easy search capabilities for the latest data and geospatial content, emphasizing transparency and accessibility for all users. The portal provides both interactive mapping applications and direct access to featured open datasets.

name: MERIT DEM
tagline: A high-accuracy global Digital Elevation Model developed by removing multiple error components from existing spaceborne DEMs.
description: The MERIT DEM is a high-accuracy global Digital Elevation Model (DEM) at 3 arcsecond resolution (~90m), created by correcting errors in existing spaceborne DEMs like SRTM3 and AW3D. It significantly improves vertical accuracy, especially in flat regions, enhancing geoscience applications dependent on terrain data.

name: Met Office DataPoint
tagline: Access meteorological data and forecasts from the UK Met Office, with a planned retirement date in 2025.
description: Met Office DataPoint is a service offering programmatic access to various weather data for developers. It provides a range of meteorological observations and forecasts through an API. Users are advised that the service has a planned retirement date of December 1, 2025.

name: Michigan & Great Lakes Data
tagline: A comprehensive guide to GIS data resources for Michigan and the Great Lakes region.
description: This resource provides a curated collection of geospatial data portals and datasets specifically focused on Michigan and the Great Lakes. It includes links to state-level open data, imagery, transportation data, and various water-related resources. The guide also features data for specific regions like Southeast Michigan and the City of Detroit.

name: Microsoft Buildings
tagline: A global dataset providing quarterly estimates of building density and height using machine learning.
description: This repository offers a global dataset of building density and height, generated quarterly by applying machine learning models to PlanetScope basemaps. It provides a global public layer and detailed data for five high-growth locations, distributed as Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFFs (COGs). The resource supports both data exploration and model training for users interested in urban development analysis.

name: Microsoft GlobalMLBuildingFootprints
tagline: Worldwide building footprints derived from satellite imagery, freely available for global use.
description: This GitHub repository provides access to 1.4 billion open building footprints detected by Bing Maps. The data is derived from various satellite imagery sources, including Maxar, Airbus, and IGN France, spanning 2014 to 2024. It is released under the ODbL license, allowing free download and use.

name: Mines GIS Data
tagline: A comprehensive guide to GIS software and geospatial data resources, with a focus on Colorado and U.S. datasets.
description: This resource from Colorado School of Mines provides an overview of available GIS software, including Esri ArcPRO and open-source QGIS. It also serves as a curated portal to numerous geospatial data sources, categorized for Colorado-specific and broader U.S. data. The guide is valuable for students and researchers seeking GIS tools and data for various projects.

name: Minnesota Geospatial Commons
tagline: A collaborative space for users and publishers of Minnesota's geospatial resources.
description: The Minnesota Geospatial Commons serves as a central hub for accessing foundational geospatial data and resources pertinent to the state of Minnesota. It fosters collaboration among various users, including researchers, developers, and planners, by providing a platform for sharing critical GIS data.

name: Mississauga Open Data
tagline: Explore a comprehensive collection of geospatial and non-geospatial data provided by the City of Mississauga.
description: The Mississauga Open Data Hub serves as a central repository for various datasets from the City of Mississauga. It provides public access to information across multiple categories, enabling users to discover, analyze, and utilize city data for various purposes.

name: Mississippi Geospatial Data Catalog
tagline: Discover, analyze, and download geospatial data from Mississippi's official open data catalog.
description: The Mississippi Geospatial Data Catalog provides a public platform for exploring, analyzing, and downloading open geospatial data for the state of Mississippi. Users can access data in various formats like CSV, KML, GeoJSON, and GeoTIFF, and utilize API links for GeoServices, WMS, and WFS. The platform also supports data visualization through charts and thematic maps, encouraging the creation of StoryMaps and Web Maps.

name: MIT Libraries GIS Data for Massachusetts
tagline: A curated guide to Geographic Information Systems (GIS) data resources for Massachusetts.
description: This LibGuide from MIT Libraries provides a centralized resource for discovering and accessing various GIS datasets relevant to the state of Massachusetts. It aims to assist researchers and students in locating essential geospatial information for their projects.

name: Model My Watershed
tagline: An online platform for exploring human impacts on watersheds, analyzing data, and simulating water quality scenarios.
description: This platform allows users to analyze mapped watershed data, visualize monitoring information, and run model simulations. It helps in understanding the effects of human activities and different conservation or development scenarios on water quality.

name: MODIS Web
tagline: The MODIS Web provides comprehensive access to Moderate Resolution Imaging Spectroradiometer (MODIS) data products from NASA.
description: This website serves as a central hub for data collected by the MODIS instruments aboard NASA's Terra and Aqua satellites. It offers a wide array of raw and processed data products covering Earth's atmosphere, land, cryosphere, and oceans. Users can access scientifically validated data for various environmental and climate research applications.

name: MondoGIS
tagline: A comprehensive collection of freely downloadable GIS data from various Italian national and regional sources.
description: MondoGIS serves as a valuable Italian online resource, curating and providing direct links to a wide array of geospatial data freely available from national entities, regional governments, and open-source initiatives. It acts as a central hub for users seeking diverse GIS datasets, from administrative boundaries to seismic information.

name: Montana Cadastral
tagline: Provides informational cadastral data for properties across Montana.
description: This service from the Montana State Library offers cadastral information for various properties within the state. It explicitly states that the data is for informational purposes only and not suitable for legal, engineering, or surveying uses. Consumers are advised to consult primary data sources for verification.

name: Montana State Library GeoInfo
tagline: Providing access to Montana's geospatial information, data, and research resources.
description: The Montana State Library's Geographic Information page serves as a central hub for geospatial data and resources related to the state. It offers access to various government publications, research materials, and supports the Montana Geospatial Information Advisory Council.

name: Montana State Library Geoinfo
tagline: The Montana State Library provides access to a wide range of geospatial data and resources for the state of Montana.
description: This platform serves as the central hub for discovering and accessing geospatial information maintained by the Montana State Library. It offers links to various data categories, supporting state, local, and federal government information. The site is a key resource for researchers and the public seeking geographical data related to Montana.

name: MRLC
tagline: Providing consistent and accurate national land cover data for the United States.
description: The Multi-Resolution Land Characteristics Consortium (MRLC) is a group of federal agencies producing the National Land Cover Database (NLCD). It offers comprehensive land cover and land cover change data, essential for environmental monitoring and research across the U.S.

name: MRLC
tagline: Provides national land cover data and related geospatial products for the United States.
description: The Multi-Resolution Land Characteristics (MRLC) Consortium offers access to comprehensive land cover data, including the National Land Cover Database (NLCD). This consortium is a partnership of federal agencies that produce consistent and timely land cover information.

name: MSDIS Open Data Site
tagline: Missouri's primary spatial data clearinghouse for distributing geospatial data layers.
description: The Missouri Spatial Data Information Service (MSDIS) serves as the primary spatial data clearinghouse for Missouri. Funded by the State of Missouri Office of Geospatial Information, it operates as a Research Support Center within the University of Missouri College of Arts & Sciences. MSDIS maintains and distributes a significant collection of vector data, aerial photography, and LiDAR elevation data.

name: NACJD
tagline: A national archive for criminal justice and criminology data.
description: The National Archive of Criminal Justice Data (NACJD) serves as a vital resource for research in criminal justice and criminology. It provides comprehensive data services, enabling users to both discover and share valuable datasets. This initiative supports empirical research and informs policy development within the criminal justice field.

name: NARWidth Data Set
tagline: The North American River Width Data Set provides planform morphometric measurements of rivers using Landsat imagery.
description: NARWidth is a geospatial data set offering planform morphometric measurements of North American rivers, derived from Landsat imagery. It includes 6.7 million georeferenced width measurements and 1.3 million flagged reservoir/lake measurements, suitable for various scientific and engineering applications like hydrologic and biogeochemical models. This data set is freely available for non-commercial scientific and educational purposes.

name: NASA / USGS Controlled Europa DTMs
tagline: High-quality digital terrain models (DTMs) of Europa's surface derived from Galileo spacecraft imagery.
description: This dataset provides stereo-derived Digital Terrain Models (DTMs) of five key sites on Jupiter's moon Europa, generated from NASA's Galileo spacecraft Solid State Imager data. These DTMs offer crucial topographical insights for understanding Europa's geology and supporting future landed missions, with manual editing for accuracy and updated pointing information for precise coordination. They are suitable for most scientific analyses, acknowledging inherent uncertainties in resolution and precision.

name: NASA Earthdata Lightning
tagline: NASA’s lightning data, collected from the ground, air, and space, help scientists understand lightning patterns and predict severe weather.
description: This resource provides access to NASA's comprehensive lightning data, gathered from various sources including ground-based sensors, airborne platforms, and satellite observations. Scientists utilize this data to gain insights into lightning patterns and to enhance the accuracy of severe weather predictions. It serves as a vital component within the broader NASA Earthdata ecosystem.

name: NASA Worldview
tagline: Interactive interface for browsing full-resolution, global, daily satellite images.
description: This interactive interface provides full-resolution, global, daily satellite imagery, often available within three hours of observation. It supports time-critical applications such as wildfire management, air quality measurements, and weather forecasting.

name: National Address Database
tagline: A comprehensive, nationwide dataset providing standardized address information for the United States.
description: The National Address Database (NAD) is a unified dataset managed by the U.S. Department of Transportation. It aims to provide a standardized, publicly available resource for addresses across the entire United States, supporting various applications requiring accurate and consistent address data.

name: National Conservation Easement Database
tagline: A comprehensive public database for conservation easements across the United States.
description: This database provides spatial data and information on conservation easements, allowing users to search, explore via an interactive map, and learn about conservation efforts. It serves as a central resource for understanding protected areas and land conservation initiatives.

name: National Hydrography Dataset
tagline: The authoritative dataset representing the water drainage network of the United States, now succeeded by 3DHP.
description: The National Hydrography Dataset (NHD) formerly detailed the water drainage network across the U.S., including rivers, streams, lakes, and dams. As of October 1, 2023, NHD data is no longer maintained but remains available, with the 3D Hydrography Program (3DHP) now serving as the most current data source.

name: National Parks & Wildlife Service
tagline: Providing access to Ireland's biodiversity, habitat, and protected site data through map viewers and open data policies.
description: The National Parks & Wildlife Service (NPWS) offers a dedicated portal for geospatial data related to Ireland's natural heritage. This platform provides access to crucial information on habitats, species, and protected areas, alongside detailed policies on data usage and standards. Users can explore various datasets and interactive map viewers for flora and protected sites.

name: National Wetlands Inventory
tagline: Provides comprehensive geospatial data on wetlands across the United States for conservation and management.
description: The U.S. Fish & Wildlife Service's National Wetlands Inventory offers publicly available geospatial data, maps, and information on the characteristics, extent, and status of wetlands. This resource supports wetland conservation, restoration, and management efforts by providing critical environmental insights.

name: Natural England Open Data Geoportal
tagline: This is Natural England's platform for sharing geospatial data and web services.
description: This is Natural England's platform for sharing geospatial data and web services. Natural England is the government’s adviser for the natural environment in England, helping to protect and restore the natural world for people to enjoy. This geoportal provides free and open access to definitive geographic products, web applications, story maps, services, and APIs, all available under the Open Government Licence v3.0 unless otherwise stated.

name: Natural Science Institute of Iceland
tagline: Iceland's primary institute for research and data on geology, flora, and natural hazards.
description: The Natural Science Institute of Iceland focuses on comprehensive research and data collection across various natural sciences. It provides information on Iceland's unique geological features, diverse flora, and significant natural hazards, contributing to scientific understanding and conservation efforts.

name: NatureServe
tagline: NatureServe provides authoritative biodiversity data and tools to guide conservation efforts across North America.
description: For nearly 50 years, NatureServe has been the authoritative source for biodiversity data throughout North America. It works with a network of organizations and scientists to collect, analyze, and deliver biodiversity knowledge that informs conservation action. The organization tracks over 100,000 species and 7,000 ecosystems, offering location-specific data crucial for targeted conservation.

name: NC OneMap
tagline: Geographic Data Serving a Statewide Community
description: NC OneMap serves as a strategic resource, offering a comprehensive collection of authoritative geographic data and web services. This collaborative initiative involves numerous partners across North Carolina, including local, state, and federal government agencies, the private sector, and academia. Users can search for, browse, and download data, integrate it into applications, perform analysis with various tools, or develop new applications using its APIs.

name: NCDOT GIS Data Layers
tagline: Provides access to the North Carolina Department of Transportation's updated GIS data layers for infrastructure and planning.
description: The NCDOT GIS Data Layers page serves as a central hub for various geospatial datasets maintained by the North Carolina Department of Transportation. It offers regularly updated information crucial for transportation planning, infrastructure management, and public access. Users can find data related to roads, rail, bridges, and administrative boundaries.

name: NDOT GeoHub
tagline: The Nevada Department of Transportation's public platform for exploring and downloading open transportation data, maps, and apps.
description: This site serves as the Nevada Department of Transportation's official GeoHub, providing authoritative transportation-themed GIS information. It offers a public platform for accessing and downloading open data, discovering applications, and engaging with NDOT's efforts to enhance Nevada's roadways.

name: Near-global 1-km freshwater variables
tagline: Global, remote-sensing supported environmental layers for assessing status and trends in biodiversity, ecosystems, and climate.
description: This dataset provides near-global, spatially continuous, and freshwater-specific environmental variables at 1km resolution. It offers remote-sensing supported environmental layers for assessing biodiversity, ecosystems, and climate status and trends, derived from upstream climate, topography, land cover, surface geology, and soil data.

name: NebraskaMap
tagline: Nebraska GIS Open Data Hubsite. This site allows the public to interface with data related to Nebraska.
description: NebraskaMap is the official GIS Open Data Hubsite for the state of Nebraska. It provides a centralized platform for the public to access and interact with a wide array of geospatial data related to the state. The site serves as a vital resource for various applications, offering insights into Nebraska's geography and resources.

name: New Hampshire Geodata Portal
tagline: Access authoritative GIS data, web applications, and related geospatial resources for New Hampshire.
description: The New Hampshire Geodata Portal, developed by NH GRANIT at UNH, provides a central hub for discovering and utilizing authoritative GIS data and related geospatial resources across New Hampshire. It offers access to various web applications and data layers, fostering partnerships with state agencies, non-profits, and the US Government to make these resources available to the public.

name: New Orleans District
tagline: Provides hydrographic survey data for channel improvement and stabilization programs.
description: This is the official public website of the New Orleans District, U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, providing access to historical hydrographic survey data. The data supports channel improvement and stabilization programs, crucial for navigation and flood control along major waterways.

name: New Popular Edition Maps
tagline: Access and contribute to historic UK Ordnance Survey maps, enhanced with crowdsourced postcode data.
description: This website provides free access to the Ordnance Survey New Popular Edition maps, covering Great Britain from the 1940s. It integrates these historic basemaps with modern, crowdsourced UK postcode data, allowing users to view and contribute to a comprehensive geographic dataset. The platform emphasizes open data principles, offering postcode data for download.

name: New York Parcels
tagline: Collecting, assembling, maintaining, and providing access to statewide tax parcel GIS data for New York.
description: This program focuses on collecting, assembling, maintaining, and providing access to statewide tax parcel GIS data for New York State. It offers public access to parcel data via direct downloads and web services, along with an assessment look-up tool.

name: New Zealand Elevation
tagline: A comprehensive collection of New Zealand's publicly owned digital elevation and surface models.
description: This dataset offers New Zealand's publicly owned digital elevation and surface models, freely available under an open license. It includes 1m resolution grids derived from LiDAR data, provided as Cloud Optimised GeoTIFFs (COGs) with LERC compression. Each elevation file is accompanied by STAC metadata, organized by region and survey, and regularly updated as new data is published.

name: NIBIS Kartenserver
tagline: A geospatial map server powered by cardo.Map, offering various mapping functionalities.
description: The NIBIS Kartenserver provides a comprehensive web mapping platform, enabling users to explore and interact with geospatial data. It offers tools for map printing, legend display, address search, and coordinate identification, alongside advanced features like measurement and elevation profiling. The platform serves as a central access point for various basemaps and thematic data layers.

name: NJGIN Open Data
tagline: Your Gateway to Geographic Information for New Jersey.
description: The NJGIN Open Data Portal, managed by the NJ Office of GIS, provides access to a wide array of geographic information for the state of New Jersey. It serves as a central hub for exploring and utilizing geospatial datasets from various state agencies and partners, facilitating data discovery and use for the public.

name: NLOG
tagline: Providing access to subsurface data and information for the Netherlands.
description: NLOG (Netherlands Oil and Gas Portal) offers a comprehensive online platform for accessing geological and subsurface data for the Netherlands. It provides access to raw and interpreted data, including boreholes, seismic data, production figures, and models, primarily derived from the DINO database.

name: NMPi
tagline: Provides access to a comprehensive catalog of marine data layers for Scotland.
description: The National Marine Plan interactive (NMPi) website offers a catalog of geospatial data layers related to marine activities and environments in Scotland. Users can browse and filter various datasets, including aquaculture sites, native oyster habitats, and other marine planning information. This platform serves as a central resource for exploring and understanding Scotland's marine assets and regulatory frameworks.

name: NOAA Coastal Lidar Data
tagline: A collection of NOAA coastal lidar data, provided in Entwine Point Tiles (EPT) and LAZ formats.
description: This resource provides NOAA Coastal Lidar Data, a collection of lidar projects focused on U.S. coastal areas. The data, measuring 3D object locations from airborne platforms, is available in Entwine Point Tiles (EPT) and LAZ formats. It includes point clouds attributed with object type, reflection intensity, and other metadata, organized by original projects with specific coordinate reference systems.

name: NOAA CoastWatch
tagline: Access and utilize global and regional satellite data for ocean and coastal applications and environmental monitoring.
description: NOAA CoastWatch provides access to global and regional satellite data for a wide range of ocean and coastal applications. This service supports research, resource management, and decision-making by offering data products and tools to understand and protect marine ecosystems and assess environmental change.

name: North American Environmental Atlas
tagline: Go Beyond Boundaries & Work Together for #Ecosystems Protection with North American Environmental Atlas & Google Earth Tours.
description: The North American Environmental Atlas provides harmonized geospatial data for Canada, Mexico, and the United States, offering a continental and regional perspective on environmental issues. It serves as a unique tool to analyze and raise awareness of shared environment and ecosystems, demonstrating their value and aiding in protection efforts. The Atlas features dozens of map layers, harmonizing geographic information across political boundaries to understand critical trends.

name: North Dakota GIS Hub Data Portal
tagline: The official portal for North Dakota geospatial data and information, managed by state agency data stewards.
description: The North Dakota GIS Hub Data Portal serves as the central access point for geospatial data and information related to the state of North Dakota. It provides a structured repository where users can discover and utilize datasets managed and maintained by various North Dakota state agencies. This portal ensures access to authoritative and thematic geospatial resources for the public and professionals.

name: NPS DataStore
tagline: A digital repository for the National Park Service, providing tools for managing and discovering park-related documents and datasets.
description: The NPS DataStore serves as a central digital repository for the National Park Service, offering robust tools for adding, organizing, and discovering documents and datasets pertinent to park resources. It supports resource management by providing access to critical information, including park boundaries, science reports, and featured content. This platform is essential for informed park planning and policy decisions.

name: NSF NCAR GDEX
tagline: Providing access to a four-kilometer long-term regional hydroclimate reanalysis dataset over the conterminous United States.
description: This resource offers access to the d559000 dataset, a four-kilometer long-term regional hydroclimate reanalysis over the conterminous United States (CONUS). It is hosted on the NSF NCAR Geoscience Data Exchange (GDEX), a platform dedicated to facilitating access to geoscience data. The platform provides various resources for data discovery, access, and analysis.

name: NSF NEON Lidar
tagline: Providing airborne lidar data and information for characterizing vegetation and surface features across U.S. ecosystems.
description: This resource details the lidar data collection methods employed by NSF NEON to map vegetation height, density, and other surface characteristics over large regions. Using airborne sensors, lidar provides detailed 3D pictures of forest structure, crucial for ecological research. It highlights the advantages of active sensors like lidar for comprehensive ecosystem parameter mapping.

name: NSW Environment Map Data
tagline: A portal for environmental mapping data from the New South Wales government.
description: This website, likely operated by the New South Wales government, appears to be designed as a hub for environmental map data. While currently inaccessible due to a "403 Forbidden" error, its domain suggests a focus on providing geospatial information related to the environment within NSW, Australia. It is presumed to offer various datasets and mapping resources for public or professional use.

name: NUVIEW
tagline: Revolutionizing Earth observation by annually mapping the planet's land surface with satellite-based LiDAR.
description: NUVIEW is a company building the first commercial satellites to annually map the planet's entire land surface with LiDAR. This initiative aims to elevate global Earth observation capabilities and provide unprecedented insights into the planet's topography and features.

name: NYC Department of City Planning
tagline: A comprehensive resource for geospatial data, tools, and maps for New York City planning and analysis.
description: This platform provides access to extensive open datasets, digital tools, and interactive maps for exploring New York City's demographics, land use, housing, and economic trends. It serves as a central hub for official geocoding technology and various data explorers to support urban planning and environmental review.

name: NYS GIS Clearinghouse
tagline: The official hub for GIS data and information within New York State.
description: The NYS GIS Clearinghouse serves as the official portal for New York State's geospatial data and information.
