It provides access to various GIS data programs, facilitates coordination among state agencies and organizations, and offers resources for geospatial professionals within the state.

name: NYS GIS Clearinghouse Data
tagline: Discover free public data, maps, applications, and other geospatial resources for New York State.
description: The NYS GIS Clearinghouse Data portal provides access to a wide array of free public geospatial data, maps, and applications for New York State. It serves as a central hub for various data programs, including parcels, streets, addresses, orthoimagery, elevation, and civil boundaries. The platform also facilitates GIS coordination and enterprise solutions for state agencies.

name: NYS GIS LIDAR
tagline: Providing access to current, in-progress, and historic LIDAR collections for New York State.
description: This platform offers comprehensive access to LIDAR datasets for New York State, including options for individual tile downloads via an application and bulk downloads through an FTP site. It also tracks the status of in-progress, planned, latest, and historic LIDAR collections across the state. Users can explore various projects and access associated metadata.

name: Náttúrufræðistofnun Íslands
tagline: Provides extensive datasets on Iceland's natural history, including place names, land surveys, vegetation, ecosystems, geology, and biodiversity.
description: The Icelandic Institute of Natural History (Náttúrufræðistofnun Íslands) offers a comprehensive data download portal. It contains extensive collections covering various aspects of Iceland's natural environment, such as geographical names, land surveying, vegetation communities, ecosystems, bedrock and superficial deposits, species distribution, fossils, and minerals.

name: OCADS
tagline: A specialized data management system for ocean carbon and acidification data.
description: The Ocean Carbon and Acidification Data System (OCADS) is a dedicated platform for managing ocean carbon and ocean acidification (OA) data. It operates within the National Centers for Environmental Information (NCEI), providing a centralized repository for critical environmental datasets.

name: OldMapsOnline
tagline: An easy-to-use portal for discovering historical maps from libraries worldwide.
description: OldMapsOnline provides a user-friendly way to explore a vast collection of historical maps from libraries across the globe. Users can browse historical locations and search for old maps using an interactive timeline, making historical cartography accessible.

name: Ontario Data Catalogue
tagline: Find public data and explore thousands of datasets published by the Government of Ontario.
description: This platform serves as the official data catalogue for the Government of Ontario, providing public access to a wide array of government data. Users can explore and download over 2900 datasets across various topics, facilitating transparency and public engagement with provincial information.

name: Open Charge Map
tagline: The global public registry of electric vehicle charging locations.
description: Open Charge Map functions as a global database for electric vehicle charging stations. It is a community-driven platform, with data managed and populated by EV drivers worldwide, providing a comprehensive public registry of charging locations.

name: Open Data Bristol
tagline: Open Data Bristol is a site for exploring, analysing and sharing data about the city.
description: Open Data Bristol provides a platform for exploring, analyzing, and sharing a wide range of public data concerning the city of Bristol. It offers datasets that can be viewed and reused by anyone, subject to their respective licenses. Users can find information on various topics, from transport and environment to population and social care.

name: Open Data DC
tagline: The District of Columbia government shares hundreds of datasets for public access and use.
description: Open Data DC is the official portal where the District of Columbia government shares hundreds of diverse datasets with the public. It invites users to browse, download, and analyze data files, or build applications using its provided APIs. This platform promotes transparency and civic engagement by making government information readily accessible.

name: Open Data MLUGEO.UAV
tagline: A metadata catalog documenting UAV flight activities and high-quality geospatial data for research.
description: This metadata catalog documents UAV flight activities conducted by the IN SITU.MLUGEO drone team, publishing all flight operations. It provides high-quality geospatial data derived from RGB, thermal, multispectral, and LiDAR sensor technology, supporting numerous research projects and study areas. Users can explore datasets via interactive search filters and submit data requests through a contact form.

name: Open Geography Portal
tagline: The UK's official Office for National Statistics Open Data Geography Site.
description: This portal provides access to the UK's official Office for National Statistics (ONS) open data geography site. It serves as a central hub for geospatial information, documents, and applications related to geographical boundaries and statistical areas within the United Kingdom.

name: Open Government Canada
tagline: A collaborative open source project providing government information and data from the Government of Canada.
description: This platform serves as the official Open Government portal for Canada, offering a wide range of public sector information. It is designed to foster transparency and accessibility, enabling citizens and organizations to access government data and resources.

name: Open Infrastructure Map
tagline: An open map of the world's electricity, telecoms, oil, gas, and water infrastructure, powered by OpenStreetMap data.
description: This platform provides a comprehensive global map visualizing critical infrastructure. It leverages OpenStreetMap data to display detailed information on power grids, communication networks, and essential utility systems worldwide, offering a valuable resource for analysis and planning.

name: Open-Meteo
tagline: Free Weather Forecast API for non-commercial use, no API key required.
description: Open-Meteo offers an open-source weather API providing free access for non-commercial applications without the need for an API key. It delivers hourly weather forecasts for up to 16 days, historical weather data spanning 80 years, and integrates various global and regional weather models.

name: OpenAddresses
tagline: OpenAddresses provides openly licensed, essential address data, connecting digital to physical places worldwide.
description: OpenAddresses is a collaborative project that aggregates and provides openly licensed address data from various sources globally. This initiative aims to establish address data as essential public infrastructure, making it freely available for a wide range of applications. Users can easily access and download existing datasets and contribute new data to expand its comprehensive global coverage.

name: OpenAerialMap
tagline: The open collection of aerial imagery
description: OpenAerialMap is an open collection and database for aerial imagery, fostering collaboration and accessibility. It provides a platform for mappers to store, share, and discover imagery, particularly from UAV efforts. Users can browse, filter, and obtain the imagery they need for various applications, including crisis response.

name: OpenDEM
tagline: OpenDTM-DE provides a free, high-resolution Digital Terrain Model for Germany, compiled from federal state data.
description: OpenDTM-DE is a project to create a unified, high-resolution Digital Terrain Model (DTM) for Germany. It aggregates freely available 1-meter resolution terrain models from individual German federal states. This initiative addresses the absence of a nationwide high-resolution DTM from the BKG, offering essential geospatial data products.

name: OpenFlights
tagline: Free airport and airline data with IATA, ICAO, latitude, longitude, elevation, timezone, and DST information.
description: OpenFlights provides a comprehensive database of airport, airline, and route data globally. This free resource offers detailed information including IATA/ICAO codes, geographic coordinates, altitude, timezone, and DST details for over 10,000 locations. It's an essential resource for anyone needing structured aviation and transportation data.

name: opengeos/geospatial-data-catalogs
tagline: A curated list of open geospatial datasets available on major cloud and data platforms.
description: This GitHub repository serves as a comprehensive catalog of open geospatial datasets. It organizes and lists data accessible through prominent platforms such as AWS, Google Earth Engine, Microsoft Planetary Computer, NASA CMR, and STAC Index, providing a valuable resource for geospatial professionals.

name: OpenTopography
tagline: High-Resolution Topography Data and Tools
description: OpenTopography provides easy, centralized access to a diverse collection of high-resolution topographic data. This platform strives to simplify data discovery by integrating data from various sources, including the USGS 3D Elevation Program. It also offers a suite of tools for processing and analyzing these datasets.

name: Oregon Explorer
tagline: Provides natural resource data, maps, and tools to support informed decision-making in Oregon.
description: This archive offers access to non-framework data layers from the retired Oregon Spatial Data Library, serving as a valuable resource for natural resource information. It complements the Oregon GEOHub, which now hosts Oregon's authoritative geospatial framework data. Users should note that the quality of data and metadata in this archive can be highly variable.

name: Oregon Spatial Data Library
tagline: Connecting users to Oregon's authoritative geospatial data and archived resources.
description: The Oregon Spatial Data Library (OSDL) served as a central access point for geospatial data, metadata, and services specific to Oregon. It has since transitioned, with its authoritative geospatial framework data now accessible via the Oregon GEOHub, while archived non-framework data is available through the Oregon Explorer. This site facilitated discovery and access to critical spatial information for the state.

name: OS Data Hub
tagline: The OS Data Hub can bring your geospatial solutions to life with our APIs, download service, data package creator and other user apps.
description: The OS Data Hub provides a comprehensive platform for geospatial solutions, offering APIs, a download service, a data package creator, and various user applications. It offers access to a wealth of free and premium Ordnance Survey products, enhancing geospatial projects with detailed mapping and environmental data.

name: OWRB Data & Maps
tagline: Access data and information regarding Oklahoma's water resources.
description: The Oklahoma Water Resources Board (OWRB) provides a centralized portal for geospatial data and information related to water resources within the state of Oklahoma. It offers access to various datasets including groundwater, surface water, water rights, and water supply. The site also features specific studies and frequently requested maps.

name: PAD-US Data Download
tagline: Download the Protected Areas Database of the United States, available nationally or by state/territory.
description: This page provides direct access to the Protected Areas Database of the United States (PAD-US). Data is offered in an ArcGIS Geodatabase format, allowing users to download comprehensive information for the entire nation or specifically by 56 individual State/Territory boundaries. It serves as a key resource for conservation and land management.

name: PALSAR-2 ScanSAR Flooding in Rwanda
tagline: A dataset providing PALSAR-2 ScanSAR observations of flooding and landslides in Rwanda.
description: This dataset contains ALOS-2 PALSAR-2 ScanSAR Level 2.1 data, offering orthorectified backscatter observations with a 350 km observation width at 25m resolution. It was generated by JAXA in response to torrential rainfall, flooding, and landslides in Rwanda, activated through the International Disaster Charter. The data provides valuable insights for disaster response and natural resource monitoring in affected regions.

name: PANGAEA.
tagline: Data Publisher for Earth & Environmental Science
description: PANGAEA offers services for archiving, publishing, and distributing georeferenced data from earth system research. As a World Data Center, it is a member of the World Data System, providing a reliable repository for scientific datasets.

name: Parcellaire Express (PCI)
tagline: Access IGN France's cadastral parcel data for French departments.
description: This service provides the Parcellaire Express (PCI) dataset, offering detailed cadastral parcel information across various departments in France. Users can download up-to-date Shapefile data, organized by departmental boundaries, for comprehensive land management and geospatial analysis. The data is provided by IGN France, a key national geographic information provider.

name: Paris Data
tagline: Bienvenue sur Paris Data ! Le site de la démarche Open Data de la Ville de Paris.
description: Paris Data serves as the official Open Data platform for the City of Paris, providing public access to a wide array of datasets. These datasets are published by various city services and their partners, all under the Open Data Commons Attribution License (ODbL) to promote transparency and reuse.

name: PastMaps
tagline: Providing access to historical maps and geospatial data for research and analysis.
description: PastMaps offers a comprehensive collection of historical maps and geospatial datasets. This platform supports researchers, historians, and planners by providing tools for exploring past landscapes and changes over time.

name: Peel Region Data Portal
tagline: An authoritative open data portal offering diverse datasets and visual tools for Peel Region, Canada.
description: This portal serves as a central hub for accessing comprehensive data pertaining to the Peel Region in Canada. Users can explore and download information on critical topics such as demographics, population trends, housing, economic activity, and regional operations. The platform also provides visual tools and reports to facilitate data analysis and understanding.

name: PennDOT Open Data
tagline: The PennShare Open Data Site provides access to Pennsylvania's published GIS data.
description: This portal offers comprehensive GIS data from the Pennsylvania Department of Transportation (PennDOT). Users can map, style, chart, download, and share various datasets related to the state's transportation infrastructure and assets.

name: Pennsylvania Spatial Data Access
tagline: A comprehensive geospatial data portal for the Commonwealth of Pennsylvania.
description: Pennsylvania Spatial Data Access (PASDA) serves as the official geospatial data clearinghouse for the Commonwealth of Pennsylvania. It provides access to a wide array of geographic information system (GIS) data, including base map themes, orthoimagery, and environmental datasets from various state agencies. The platform facilitates data discovery and download for researchers, government agencies, and the public.

name: Pennsylvania State Data Center
tagline: Making federal census and socioeconomic data accessible and useful for Pennsylvania decision-makers.
description: The Pennsylvania State Data Center (PASDC) serves as the official source of demographic and socioeconomic data for the Commonwealth of Pennsylvania. It partners with the U.S. Census Bureau to provide local access to federal statistics, assisting users with information acquisition, data evaluation, and interpretation.

name: Perry-Castañeda Library Map Collection
tagline: The University of Texas at Austin's extensive map collection provides a vast resource for geographic research and historical study.
description: The Perry-Castañeda Library Map Collection at the University of Texas at Austin houses a comprehensive array of maps, atlases, and geospatial data. It serves as a significant resource for students, researchers, and the public, offering access to diverse cartographic materials for various academic and historical purposes.

name: Placekey
tagline: Solve Address Matching with a Free Universal Location ID
description: Placekey is a universal place identifier trusted by organizations, businesses, and geospatial scientists to easily represent and unify location data. It is built with developers in mind to facilitate the joining and combining of geospatial data from diverse sources, leading to more comprehensive insights.

name: Planet Education and Research Program
tagline: The Planet Education and Research Program offers university-affiliated students and researchers limited, non-commercial access to PlanetScope and RapidEye imagery.
description: This program provides university-affiliated students, faculty, and researchers with limited, non-commercial access to PlanetScope and RapidEye satellite imagery. It enables the study of global change, forest dynamics, urban growth, and agricultural yields using daily, high-resolution data for academic projects.

name: POI Factory
tagline: A community for sharing free GPS Points of Interest (POI) files and discussing related topics.
description: POI Factory has been a friendly online community since 2006, where users can share and discuss GPS files. The website provides access to over 1,000,000 free POI locations, covering a wide array of categories from retail and dining to outdoor activities and attractions. It serves as a valuable resource for GPS users looking to enhance their navigation with custom datasets.

name: Polar View
tagline: A website about Polar View and related services in the Antarctic region.
description: This platform provides access to a variety of geospatial datasets focusing on the Antarctic. It serves as a central hub for researchers and users to explore and download critical environmental data, including satellite imagery and ice-related products. The service aims to support monitoring and analysis of the dynamic polar environment.

name: Population Density Maps
tagline: Access detailed population density maps for humanitarian and development efforts.
description: This platform provides detailed population density maps, likely derived from Facebook's extensive user data and AI analysis. These maps are invaluable for researchers, humanitarian organizations, and development agencies to understand population distribution and density across various regions. The data supports critical decision-making in disaster response, public health initiatives, and infrastructure planning.

name: Poseidon 3D Seismic, Australia
tagline: A 3D seismic dataset for oil and gas exploration in Australia, openly available on AWS.
description: This dataset provides near, mid, far, and full stack (with AGC) imaged 3D seismic data, along with a decimated stacking velocity field. Covering approximately 2,900 km2, it is primarily used in oil and gas exploration within Australia. The data is converted to open-source MDIO format and hosted on AWS S3, licensed under CC BY 4.0.

name: PRIO
tagline: Peace Research Institute Oslo (PRIO) provides public access to a diverse collection of research data and datasets.
description: PRIO is dedicated to making its extensive research data publicly available for replication and further study. The platform offers a wide array of datasets derived from various PRIO projects and publications, covering critical global issues. These resources are invaluable for researchers and analysts in peace and conflict studies.

name: Proba-V-TerraNorte Forest Maps
tagline: Developing forest cover maps using Proba-V satellite data for environmental monitoring.
description: This initiative by the Space Research Institute of the Russian Academy of Sciences focuses on satellite monitoring technologies. The project utilizes satellite imagery, such as that from Proba-V, to create detailed maps of forest cover. These maps are a key output of the Proba-V-TerraNorte project, contributing to environmental understanding.

name: Protected Planet
tagline: The most up-to-date and complete source of data on protected areas and other effective area-based conservation measures (OECMs).
description: Protected Planet provides comprehensive and current data on protected areas and OECMs globally. It is updated monthly with submissions from governments, NGOs, landowners, and communities, offering vital information for conservation efforts. The platform showcases global statistics and allows exploration by regional, country, or individual area levels.

name: Puget Sound LIDAR Consortium
tagline: A historical portal for LiDAR data in the Puget Sound region, now largely superseded by newer resources.
description: The Puget Sound LIDAR Consortium (PSLC) website provides access to historical LiDAR data for the Puget Sound area. While no longer actively maintained, it served as an important early resource for researchers and the public. Users are now directed to the more current Washington Department of Natural Resources LiDAR portal for up-to-date information and data.

name: Queensland DDS Search (Unavailable)
tagline: The Queensland Data Delivery Service search page is currently unavailable.
description: This URL, intended for searching the Queensland Data Delivery Service, is currently returning an HTTP 404 Not Found error. The page cannot be accessed, suggesting it may have been removed, moved, or is temporarily offline.

name: Rain over Africa
tagline: Provides spaceborn precipitation estimates for Africa using deep learning and geostationary imagery.
description: The Rain over Africa (RoA) dataset offers spaceborn precipitation estimates for Africa, derived from geostationary imagery using convolutional and quantile regression neural networks. It includes uncertainty estimates and is updated at most yearly, licensed under CC BY 4.0. This dataset is part of the Registry of Open Data on AWS, making it discoverable on AWS Data Exchange.

name: Randolph Glacier Inventory (RGI)
tagline: A globally complete inventory of glacier outlines for monitoring the world's changing glaciers.
description: The Randolph Glacier Inventory (RGI) is a comprehensive dataset providing outlines of glaciers worldwide, excluding ice sheets. It serves as a snapshot of global glaciers, primarily targeting the year 2000, and is crucial for large-scale analyses of glacier volume and climate response. The RGI is a subset of the broader GLIMS initiative.

name: RapidCrops
tagline: A pan-European label dataset providing harmonized crop type information for large-scale agricultural classification.
description: RapidCrops offers 99 million agricultural parcel boundaries with harmonized crop type data across seven EU countries, spanning 5-7 years. The dataset is derived from the EU IACS programme and includes attributes to support machine learning workflows, particularly those leveraging Earth Observation data.

name: RarePlanes
tagline: A unique open-source machine learning dataset featuring real and synthetic satellite imagery for aircraft detection.
description: RarePlanes is an open-source machine learning dataset from CosmiQ Works and AI.Reverie, designed to test the value of synthetic data in computer vision. It combines real Maxar WorldView-3 satellite imagery with synthetically generated data to enhance algorithms for automatic aircraft detection and attribute identification. This dataset is the largest openly available very high-resolution resource for synthetic data testing in an overhead perspective.

name: Regrid
tagline: Authoritative parcel data with boundaries across the U.S. & Canada.
description: Regrid offers comprehensive, government-sourced parcel data for the United States and Canada, supporting confident decision-making across various sectors. The platform provides access to detailed land data, including parcel boundaries and associated property information. Users can leverage this data for real estate, urban planning, and other geospatial analysis needs.

name: RGIS
tagline: Browse and access a vast collection of geospatial data for New Mexico, including rasters, vectors, and files.
description: RGIS, hosted by the University of New Mexico, serves as a comprehensive data portal for geographic information systems data focused on New Mexico. It provides access to a wide array of datasets categorized by themes such as agriculture, boundaries, climate, elevation, environment, and transportation. Users can search, browse, and download spatial data in various formats, often with associated metadata.

name: RIGIS
tagline: Rhode Island Geographic Information System (RIGIS) open GIS data distribution clearinghouse
description: The Rhode Island Geographic Information System (RIGIS) operates as an open GIS data distribution clearinghouse for the state. It provides access to a diverse range of geographically-referenced datasets, covering essential topics such as transportation, infrastructure, and the environment, facilitating public access and analysis.

name: Riverscapes Consortium
tagline: Connecting individuals and building communities for healthy riverscapes through science, conservation, and restoration.
description: The Riverscapes Consortium is a collective of scientists, restoration practitioners, managers, and conservationists dedicated to addressing urgent riverscape challenges. It works to advance science, build community, develop tools, and distribute data to increase capacity and knowledge, inspiring action for improved riverscape health.

name: RoadDetections
tagline: Microsoft offers a global dataset of road detections derived from Bing Maps aerial imagery, freely available for download.
description: This resource provides a comprehensive dataset of 54.2 million kilometers of roads detected worldwide using Microsoft Maps aerial imagery, including Maxar and Airbus sources. The data is openly accessible under the Open Data Commons Open Database License (ODbL), with plans to open-source the underlying AI model and geometry generation code in 2025.

name: Rockd
tagline: Explore and document the geologic world with instant access to geological data and observation tools.
description: rockd provides users with immediate access to geological information and a dashboard that summarizes key facts about their current location. It enables easy recording of geological observations, offering spatially informed suggestions for nearby units, time intervals, and fossils. Users can track their progress through the geologic record with summary statistics.

name: Rulamahue.cl
tagline: An online atlas providing detailed maps of Chile's regions, provinces, and communes.
description: Rulamahue.cl hosts a comprehensive online atlas featuring maps and plans of Chile's administrative divisions. It offers geographical information for all regions, provinces, and communes, making the data available for sharing and reuse under a Creative Commons license. This resource is valuable for geographical research and educational purposes related to Chile.

name: SAGE
tagline: SAGE fosters interdisciplinary research on global environmental problems and human-environment interactions.
description: The Center for Sustainability and the Global Environment (SAGE) at the University of Wisconsin-Madison conducts interdisciplinary research. It focuses on regional and global environmental problems, examining the complex interactions between environmental systems, natural resources, and human activities, while also providing data and models.

name: Satellitemap.space
tagline: Discover live positions of Starlink, SpaceX, Kuiper & GPS satellites with an interactive map.
description: This platform offers real-time tracking of Starlink, SpaceX, Kuiper, and GPS satellites using an interactive WebGL map. Users can explore live satellite positions, launch tables, and coverage information, with upcoming features like orbital decay predictions and satellite train tracking. It provides a comprehensive visualization of internet constellations and individual satellites.

name: Satlas Super Resolution
tagline: Provides open AI-generated global super-resolution geospatial imagery, updated frequently.
description: Satlas Super Resolution offers globally generated AI-enhanced imagery for 2023, aiming for high accuracy and frequent updates. This GitHub repository provides the training and inference code, data, and model weights for the super-resolution outputs. It supports the mission of Satlas to provide open, AI-generated geospatial data.

name: SatPM2.5
tagline: Estimates global fine particulate matter (PM2.5) concentrations using a fusion of satellite, simulation, and monitor data.
description: SatPM2.5 provides comprehensive estimates of fine particulate matter (PM2.5) concentrations by integrating aerosol optical depth from multiple satellites (MODIS, VIIRS, MISR, SeaWiFS) with simulation models (GEOS-Chem) and ground-based measurements. This geophysical estimate is further refined through statistical fusion with direct PM2.5 measurements to explain most of the variance observed. The dataset is updated yearly and is available under a Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International license.

name: SC DHEC GIS Hub
tagline: A public platform for exploring and downloading open geospatial data from the SC Department of Health and Environmental Control.
description: The SC DHEC GIS Hub serves as a public platform for accessing and downloading open geospatial data related to health and environmental control in South Carolina. It provides data categories such as water, air, coastal, land, and health, encouraging users to engage with important local issues. The hub also offers guidance on accessing Rest Services for more advanced data consumption.

name: SCDNR GIS Open Data
tagline: A centralized hub for authoritative geospatial data and applications from the South Carolina Department of Natural Resources.
description: This site provides access to a wide range of geospatial datasets, StoryMaps, and web applications from the South Carolina Department of Natural Resources. It features categorized data including Conservation, Water Resources, Geology, Marine Resources, and Imagery. Users can explore and download critical environmental and natural resource information for South Carolina.

name: SCDOT GIS Mapping
tagline: Provides downloadable GIS data for roadways and traffic counts in South Carolina.
description: The South Carolina Department of Transportation (SCDOT) offers a dedicated portal for Geographic Information System (GIS) data. This resource provides free, downloadable datasets related to the state's transportation infrastructure, including detailed roadway networks and historical traffic count information. Users can access various years of traffic data in both line and point formats.

name: Sea Ice Today
tagline: Daily updates and analysis on Arctic and Antarctic sea ice conditions.
description: This website provides daily updates and scientific analysis of Arctic and Antarctic sea ice conditions. It is a key resource from the National Snow and Ice Data Center (NSIDC) for monitoring changes in the cryosphere, offering critical insights into environmental shifts and climate change impacts.

name: SensatUrban
tagline: An urban-scale point cloud dataset for semantic segmentation research with billions of annotated points.
description: SensatUrban is a large-scale photogrammetric point cloud dataset designed for urban semantic segmentation research. It features nearly three billion richly annotated points, covering approximately 6 km² across two UK cities. This dataset provides essential benchmarks and challenges for advancing 3D point cloud analysis and deep learning applications.

name: Sentinel-1
tagline: Access the global Sentinel-1 GRD archive, converted to cloud-optimized GeoTIFF format, freely available on AWS.
description: This resource provides access to the global Sentinel-1 GRD archive, encompassing data from its inception to the present. The data is converted into cloud-optimized GeoTIFF format, making it readily available for various applications. It supports diverse use cases, including land and sea monitoring, emergency response for environmental disasters, and economic applications.

name: Sentinel-1 Backscatter Imagery
tagline: Analysis-ready Sentinel-1 C-band SAR imagery for environmental monitoring over the Contiguous United States.
description: This dataset offers Radiometrically Terrain Corrected (RTC) Sentinel-1 C-band Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) imagery, processed from original Ground Range Detected (GRD) scenes. It provides analysis-ready data, suitable for environmental monitoring, available over the Contiguous United States (CONUS) since 2017. The data is managed by Indigo Ag, Inc. and targets daily updates.

name: Sentinel-2
tagline: Access high-resolution optical imagery from the Sentinel-2 mission, freely available on the Registry of Open Data on AWS.
description: This AWS registry provides free and open access to Sentinel-2 satellite imagery, a land monitoring mission offering high-resolution optical data globally every five days. It includes both L1C and L2A data, regularly updated within hours of availability. The data supports various ongoing studies and applications.

name: Sentinel-2 Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFFs
tagline: Cloud-optimized Sentinel-2 satellite imagery for land monitoring and Earth observation on AWS.
description: This dataset provides Sentinel-2 Level-2A satellite imagery in Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFF (COG) format, offering high-resolution optical data for land monitoring. It includes global coverage with frequent updates, accessible via AWS, and is accompanied by SpatioTemporal Asset Catalog (STAC) metadata, making it easily discoverable and usable for various geospatial applications.

name: SNIAmb
tagline: Portugal's National Environmental Information System for data access and geographic visualization.
description: SNIAmb (Sistema Nacional de Informação do Ambiente) is Portugal's National Environmental Information System. It provides structured access to a wide array of environmental data and offers geographic visualization tools across various thematic areas, supporting environmental management and public consultation processes.

name: Snow Data Assimilation System (SNODAS)
tagline: Provides comprehensive snow data products from the National Snow and Ice Data Center (NSIDC).
description: This resource offers access to Snow Data Assimilation System (SNODAS) data products, managed by the National Snow and Ice Data Center (NSIDC). SNODAS provides crucial information on snow cover, depth, and water equivalent, essential for cryospheric and hydrological research.

name: Soar Atlas
tagline: A platform for discovering and accessing global geospatial data.
description: Soar Atlas provides a centralized platform for users to explore and access a wide array of geospatial datasets. It aims to simplify the discovery process for various types of imagery and spatial information, making complex data more readily available.

name: SoilGrids
tagline: A global system for digital soil mapping providing detailed soil property data at 250m resolution.
description: SoilGrids is a comprehensive web portal offering global digital soil maps at a 250-meter resolution. It provides detailed information on various soil properties, derived from a global compilation of soil profile data and environmental layers, making it a valuable resource for environmental analysis.

name: SpaceFromSpace
tagline: Browse free high-resolution satellite imagery, past and present, of spaceports, cities, and more worldwide.
description: SpaceFromSpace provides free access to high-resolution satellite imagery, featuring both current-day and historic declassified spy satellite images. The platform allows users to explore various global locations, including spaceports and cities, offering unique perspectives on inaccessible areas and environmental changes.

name: SRTM Tile Grabber
tagline: An interactive web tool for identifying and accessing SRTM elevation data tiles, now pointing to external download sources.
description: The SRTM Tile Grabber was designed to facilitate the download of Shuttle Radar Topography Mission (SRTM) elevation data tiles. Although direct download links from this tool are no longer functional as of January 2021, it remains a valuable resource for identifying specific SRTM tile names. Users can still use the map to determine which 90-meter resolution GeoTIFF files to download from external mirrors like CGIAR's website.

name: Stadt Wien Geodatenviewer
tagline: Provides free geobasic data for the entire Vienna city area through the Open Government Vienna (OGD) initiative.
description: The Surveying and Geoinformation Department (MA 41) of the City of Vienna offers free geobasic data for the entire Vienna city area. This initiative, part of Open Government Vienna (OGD), makes essential geospatial information readily available to the public.

name: State Cartographer's Office
tagline: Find geospatial data for Wisconsin from various local, state, and federal sources.
description: The State Cartographer's Office (SCO) at UW–Madison serves as a primary resource for locating commonly-requested Wisconsin geospatial datasets. This platform helps users navigate the fragmented landscape of data availability, as Wisconsin currently lacks a single, statewide geospatial data download site. It connects users to various data categories from local, state, and federal sources.

name: State of Alaska Geoportal
tagline: Alaska Geospatial Council ArcGIS Online Hub Site for open data and services.
description: The Alaska Open Data Geoportal is a cooperative project coordinated by the Alaska Geospatial Office, providing access to a wide array of geospatial data and services. These resources are hosted by various public agencies across the state, fostering collaboration and data sharing.

name: State of Idaho GIS Hub
tagline: Explore authoritative data, maps, applications, and tools from Idaho's State Agencies.
description: This hub provides access to authoritative geospatial data, maps, applications, and tools from Idaho's State Agencies. It serves as a central point for discovering datasets that contribute to the Idaho Spatial Data Infrastructure (Idaho SDI), facilitating exploration and utilization of state-level GIS resources.

name: State of Michigan
tagline: A comprehensive open data portal for Michigan geospatial datasets, offering browse, search, and download capabilities.
description: This platform provides access to a wide array of Michigan geospatial datasets, allowing users to browse by category or search by keywords. It enables previewing and exploring attributes of datasets before downloading them in various formats like ESRI shapefile, spreadsheet, KML, or via API.

name: State of South Dakota
tagline: This site provides access to publicly available data for the State of South Dakota.
description: The State of South Dakota Open Data site serves as a central hub for geospatial data and information. It offers public access to a variety of datasets, map galleries, and applications from various state departments. This platform facilitates data discovery and utilization for citizens, researchers, and government agencies.

name: State of Tennessee GIS Data
tagline: Providing public access to open geographic data from various Tennessee state agencies.
description: The State of Tennessee offers a comprehensive open data portal for geographic information. Users can easily search for, preview, and download a wide array of GIS data contributed by various state agencies. This initiative promotes transparency and accessibility of valuable geospatial resources for public use.

name: Statistics Canada Road Network Files
tagline: Digital representations of Canada's national road network, including street names, types, directions, and address ranges.
description: These files provide digital representations of Canada's national road network, derived from the 2011 Census. They contain detailed attribute information like street names, types, directions, and address ranges, making them essential for various geospatial applications and analyses across Canada.

name: Statistics Finland
tagline: Statistics Finland provides open geographic data, primarily statistical areas and linked statistical information.
description: Statistics Finland offers open geographic data, mainly comprising statistical areas and associated statistical data. This page serves as a central hub for information regarding the contents, interfaces, and implementation instructions for their open geographic data resources. These datasets are an integral part of the national geographic information infrastructure of Finland.

name: STRI Scientific Databases
tagline: Access extensive scientific databases curated by the Smithsonian Tropical Research Institute for tropical ecosystems research.
description: The Smithsonian Tropical Research Institute (STRI) offers access to a variety of scientific databases, supporting research into tropical biodiversity and ecosystems. These resources are vital for scientists studying the unique environments of the tropics, particularly in Panama.

name: swissALTI3D
tagline: An extremely precise digital elevation model describing the surface of Switzerland without vegetation and development.
description: swissALTI3D is a highly accurate digital elevation model that captures the surface of Switzerland, excluding vegetation and development. It provides foundational height data for various applications and is updated every six years to maintain its precision.

name: swisstopo
tagline: Provides comprehensive geodata and applications for Switzerland, including digital maps, imagery, and 3D models.
description: swisstopo is the national mapping agency of Switzerland, offering a wide array of geospatial data products and services. These include various digital maps, aerial and satellite imagery, landscape and height models, and specialized geological and aeronautical maps. The organization also develops and maintains geodetic software to support surveying and mapping needs.

name: TACO
tagline: A large-scale trash dataset for computer vision, enabling AI to detect and combat litter.
description: The TACO dataset addresses the critical need for annotated images to train deep learning models for trash detection. It aims to advance AI applications in environmental monitoring, such as drone-based trash surveying and robotic litter collection, by providing a comprehensive and continually updated collection of segmented trash images.

name: TanDEM-X Science Server
tagline: Providing access to global TanDEM-X Synthetic Aperture Radar data for scientific research.
description: The TanDEM-X Science Server offers researchers and scientists access to high-resolution Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) data and Digital Elevation Models (DEMs) derived from the TanDEM-X mission. This platform supports a wide range of scientific applications by providing crucial geospatial information for Earth observation.

name: TCCON Data Archive
tagline: A global network providing precise column-averaged abundances of atmospheric gases from ground-based Fourier Transform Spectrometers.
description: This archive provides accurate and precise column-averaged abundances of various atmospheric gases like CO2, CH4, and H2O, retrieved from direct solar spectra recorded by the TCCON network. Data is publicly available in netCDF format, along with auxiliary information like averaging kernels and a priori profiles for research and analysis.

name: Tech Blog
tagline: Benchmarks & Tips for Big Data, Hadoop, AWS, Google Cloud, PostgreSQL, Spark, Python & More...
description: This blog provides benchmarks and tips for working with big data, cloud platforms, and various geospatial datasets. It features in-depth analyses of large-scale open data, satellite imagery, and GIS software applications. The content covers a range of topics from data center locations to global building footprints and advanced imagery processing.

name: TerraDrought
tagline: TerraDrought provides near-real-time global drought monitoring and impact analysis.
description: TerraDrought offers a comprehensive platform for global drought monitoring, delivering near-real-time insights by integrating forecasts, observations, and impact reports. It helps users anticipate risks and respond effectively to drought conditions worldwide, providing detailed analysis of drought intensity and societal impacts.

name: The National Map - Data Delivery
tagline: Providing access to foundational geospatial data for the United States through The National Map.
description: This official U.S. Geological Survey (USGS) page serves as a portal for data delivery from The National Map. It offers various types of geospatial information and mapping products for the United States, supporting diverse scientific research and public needs. Users can access foundational data for various applications.

name: theLIST
tagline: Sharing Tasmanian location based information
description: The LIST (Land Information System Tasmania) provides a comprehensive portal for accessing location-based data and services across Tasmania, Australia. Users can explore and acquire various geospatial datasets, maps, and property information, supporting diverse applications from environmental management to urban planning. This platform serves as a central hub for government agencies, businesses, and the public to utilize authoritative spatial data.

name: TIGER Data Products Guide
tagline: Help determining which TIGER Product to use for geospatial and demographic analysis.
description: This guide from the U.S. Census Bureau assists users in selecting the appropriate TIGER (Topologically Integrated Geographic Encoding and Referencing) data product for their needs. It details the various geographic data offerings, ensuring users can effectively leverage Census Bureau information for analysis and mapping initiatives.

name: TNGIS
tagline: Tennessee's Geographic Data Clearinghouse.
description: TNGIS serves as Tennessee's official geographic data clearinghouse, cataloging and sharing authoritative spatial data sources for the state. It provides a centralized hub for users to explore and access various geospatial datasets.

name: TNM Download v2
tagline: A simplified client for downloading geospatial products from The National Map.
description: The TNM Download Client offers a user-friendly interface built on modern web technologies for accessing and downloading various products from The National Map. It streamlines the process of finding and acquiring geospatial data, including topographic maps and national boundary datasets.

name: TNMap
tagline: The State of Tennessee's portal for comprehensive GIS data, applications, and services.
description: TNMap serves as a centralized hub for accessing downloadable GIS datasets, a variety of web applications, and data services for the state of Tennessee. Its primary goal is to support and serve the geospatial community within Tennessee by providing essential resources.

name: TOD Database
tagline: Provides economic and demographic information for transit-oriented development across U.S. metropolitan areas.
description: The National TOD Database, a project by the Center for Transit-Oriented Development, offers economic and demographic data for existing and proposed fixed guideway transit stations in the U.S. It serves as a vital tool for planners, developers, government officials, and academics, providing detailed insights at multiple geographic levels.

name: Toporama
tagline: Natural Resources Canada provides Toporama, an online topographic map viewer.
description: Toporama, provided by Natural Resources Canada, offers an interactive topographic map viewer as part of The Atlas of Canada. It allows users to explore detailed topographic information for various regions within Canada, making it a valuable resource for geographic data and mapping.

name: Trainline EU Stations
tagline: A GitHub repository providing a comprehensive list of train stations and their associated metadata.
description: This open-source GitHub repository serves as a central hub for train station data. It includes extensive metadata for various stations, making it a valuable resource for developers and data analysts working with transportation information. The project encourages community contributions to maintain and expand the dataset.

name: Tsunamis
tagline: NCEI provides a comprehensive historical database of tsunami events globally.
description: NCEI and the World Data Service for Geophysics maintain the Global Historical Tsunami Database. This unique resource supports tsunami warning centers, engineers, oceanographers, seismologists, and the public by providing information on tsunami events from 2000 B.C. to the present across major oceans and seas.

name: TxDOT Open Data Portal
tagline: Texas Department of Transportation's gateway to GIS data.
description: The TxDOT Open Data Portal provides access to a wide range of geospatial data from the Texas Department of Transportation. Users can explore, filter, and download GIS datasets related to transportation infrastructure, planning, safety, and more. This platform serves as a central hub for accessing crucial public data for analysis and projects.

name: TxGIO DataHub
tagline: A comprehensive data hub providing access to a wide range of Texas geospatial data and services.
description: The TxGIO DataHub serves as a central repository for geospatial data pertaining to Texas. It offers various data categories including imagery, elevation, hydrography, and transportation, accessible through multiple delivery methods. Users can download, access external links, or order specific datasets.

name: U.S. Census Bureau Cartographic Boundary Files
tagline: Access U.S. Census Bureau cartographic boundary files in shapefile format for various years.
description: This U.S. Census Bureau resource provides access to cartographic boundary files. These files are available in shapefile format, offering geographic data for the United States across different years. Users can download these datasets for mapping and analysis purposes.

name: U.S. Geological Survey Water Data
tagline: Providing fundamental water information and datasets for economic well-being and effective resource management.
description: The U.S. Geological Survey's Water Resources Mission Area offers essential water information and datasets. These resources are crucial for economic well-being, protecting life and property, and supporting effective management of water resources across the nation. The site lists discrete data releases and datasets produced during their science and research activities.

name: U.S. Office of Coast Survey
tagline: Official source for U.S. nautical charts, publications, and navigation updates from NOAA's Office of Coast Survey.
description: The U.S. Office of Coast Survey provides official nautical charts and related hydrographic products for safe navigation. This federal agency, part of NOAA and the U.S. Department of Commerce, offers various chart formats, publications like the Coast Pilot, and tools for mariners.

name: UCDP
tagline: Providing one of the most accurate and well-used data-sources on global armed conflicts since the 1970s.
description: The Uppsala Conflict Data Program (UCDP) systematically records and defines ongoing violent conflicts globally. It offers one of the most accurate and widely used data sources on armed conflicts, with its definition becoming a standard for systematic conflict study.

name: UGRC
tagline: Utah's map technology coordination office.
description: The Utah Geospatial Resource Center (UGRC) aggregates and makes available important statewide data sets. It engages and advises on GIS implementations and best practices, and builds custom tools, services, and applications for all levels of government.

name: UH Manoa Library GIS Data Guide
tagline: A comprehensive guide to GIS data resources, organized by geography, with a strong focus on Hawaiʻi and Pacific Islands.
description: This resource provides a curated list of GIS data sources, categorized geographically, primarily for Hawaiʻi and the broader Pacific Islands region. It includes links to state and county GIS portals, specialized datasets like bathymetry and climate data, and commercial imagery providers. The guide serves as a valuable starting point for researchers seeking geospatial information for these specific areas.

name: UK Live Traffic Cameras
tagline: Real-time monitoring of the UK’s 4,339 live traffic cameras.
description: This website offers real-time access to live traffic camera feeds across the United Kingdom. It centralizes data from thousands of cameras, providing current road conditions and traffic flow information. Users can view popular and most-viewed cameras to monitor specific routes.

name: UK National Atmospheric Emissions Inventory
tagline: Providing comprehensive data on atmospheric emissions across the United Kingdom.
description: The UK National Atmospheric Emissions Inventory (NAEI) is a key resource for tracking and reporting on atmospheric emissions within the UK. It compiles detailed data on various pollutants, supporting environmental policy development and research.

name: UK Pollutant Deposition
tagline: Provides UK information on atmospheric pollutant deposition and its environmental effects.
description: This website offers comprehensive information on atmospheric pollutant deposition across the UK. It details the effects of poor air quality on human health and ecosystems, covering both wet and dry deposition processes. The site focuses on key components like sulphur, reactive nitrogen, and heavy metals, complementing other UK air quality resources.

name: Umbra SAR Open Data
tagline: Umbra provides high-resolution Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) imagery as open data on AWS for diverse monitoring and analysis.
description: This program offers high-resolution Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) imagery from Umbra satellites, with resolutions up to 16-cm. SAR data can penetrate clouds and darkness, making it ideal for continuous monitoring and change detection. The Open Data Program provides frequently updated time-series locations and a collection of global images for various applications.

name: UMN Geospatial Data
tagline: A comprehensive guide to online GIS data and resources from the University of Minnesota Libraries.
description: This guide from the University of Minnesota Libraries serves as a robust, though not exhaustive, resource for geospatial data. It aims to identify and provide access to a wide array of online GIS data and related resources, suitable for various research and learning needs. The collection encompasses both globally accessible and institutionally licensed datasets, covering diverse geographic scales and thematic areas.

name: University of Alberta Library Geospatial
tagline: A subject guide to geospatial data, GIS resources, and printed maps at the University of Alberta Library.
description: This guide provides access to geospatial data, GIS resources, and printed maps available through the University of Alberta Library. It specifically highlights free geospatial data for the province of Alberta, including provincial and NGO sources. The guide also covers broader topics like international and Canadian data, restricted spatial data, databases, and software.

name: University of Nebraska–Lincoln SNR
tagline: A comprehensive repository of GIS data and online resources from the School of Natural Resources.
description: This website serves as a central hub for geographic information system (GIS) data and online resources curated by the University of Nebraska–Lincoln's School of Natural Resources. It offers access to diverse datasets covering environmental, geological, and climate-related topics for research and public use, primarily focusing on Nebraska.

name: UNR Libraries GIS Guide
tagline: A comprehensive guide to GIS data resources, offering access to local, governmental, and international datasets.
description: This page, part of the University of Nevada, Reno Libraries' GIS guide, provides a curated collection of links to various geospatial datasets. It features resources ranging from local Nevada county and city open data portals to broader Earth Sciences, Demographic, Economic, and Geocoding resources. The guide aims to assist users in locating diverse data for their GIS projects.

name: US Census Data on Planetary Computer
tagline: Provides access to comprehensive US Census demographic and geographic data hosted on Microsoft Planetary Computer.
description: This resource offers access to detailed US Census demographic and geographic data, integrated within the Microsoft Planetary Computer ecosystem. Users can leverage this extensive dataset for various analytical tasks, including population studies, urban planning, and socio-economic research. The platform facilitates efficient data processing and analysis through its cloud-native capabilities.

name: US EPA Enterprise Data Catalog
tagline: Gateway to environmental datasets and information from the US EPA, serving as a comprehensive data hub.
description: This platform serves as the central Environmental Dataset Gateway for the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency. It provides access to a wide array of environmental data, information, laws, and regulations, enabling users to find and utilize critical resources for environmental protection and research.

name: US Fish and Wildlife Service Open Data
tagline: The official open data portal for the US Fish and Wildlife Service.
description: This is the official open data portal for the US Fish and Wildlife Service (FWS). It serves as a central source for authoritative and publicly shared geospatial content. The portal aims to provide data and information to support conservation efforts across the nation.

name: US Parcel Layer
tagline: A comprehensive dataset providing detailed property parcel boundaries and associated land information for the United States.
description: This dataset offers extensive geospatial information on land parcels across the United States. It includes property boundaries, ownership details, and various land attributes, making it a valuable resource for real estate analysis, urban planning, and geographic research.

name: USAGov
tagline: Learn about the census, which happens every 10 years and counts every resident in the United States.
description: This official United States government website provides comprehensive information about the U.S. Census, a decennial count of every resident. It serves as a resource for understanding census data and offers guidance on how to search for specific data by state, county, or city.

name: USDA Forest Service FSGeodata Clearinghouse
tagline: The USDA Forest Service FSGeodata Clearinghouse provides public access to a wide range of geospatial data and mapping products.
description: This clearinghouse serves as a central repository for the U.S. Forest Service's geospatial data. It offers downloadable datasets, map services, and various raster and vector products relevant to forestry, land management, and environmental monitoring. Users can explore data related to forest conditions, land cover, hazards, and topographic features.

name: USDA Geospatial Data Gateway
tagline: The official gateway for accessing geospatial data from the USDA Natural Resources Conservation Service.
description: This platform provides users with access to a wide variety of geospatial datasets related to natural resources, managed by the USDA's Natural Resources Conservation Service (NRCS). It serves as a central hub for ordering and directly downloading critical environmental and agricultural data for the United States.

name: USGS 3DEP LiDAR Point Clouds
tagline: Access the USGS 3D Elevation Program's LiDAR point cloud data hosted on AWS Open Data.
description: This dataset provides access to the USGS 3D Elevation Program (3DEP) LiDAR point cloud data covering the conterminous United States, Hawaii, and U.S. territories. It offers two data realizations: public access Entwine Point Tiles (EPT) and Requester Pays access to the original Raw LAZ format. The data is periodically updated and available under a US Government Public Domain license.

name: USGS FSU Coal Spatial Data
tagline: Provides downloadable spatial data and metadata for coal sample points, deposits, and basins from the former Soviet Union.
description: This USGS Open-File Report offers a directory of spatial data related to coal in the former Soviet Union. It includes datasets for coal sample points, coal deposits, and coal basins, derived from various geological surveys and compiled by the USGS. Data is available in multiple GIS and text formats for direct download.

name: USGS Projects in Afghanistan
tagline: Providing geospatial reference datasets and scientific research for Afghanistan.
description: This USGS website serves as a hub for geospatial reference datasets and scientific project information related to Afghanistan. It details various science initiatives, including studies in biology, climate, geology, and natural hazards, offering foundational data for diverse applications.

name: USGSNAIPPlus
tagline: The USGS NAIP Plus service provides high-resolution orthoimagery from NAIP and HRO for the conterminous United States.
description: This service from The National Map offers National Agriculture Imagery Program (NAIP) and high-resolution orthoimagery (HRO). It combines visual attributes of aerial photographs with the spatial accuracy of maps, with resolutions varying from 6 inches to 1 meter. The imagery is available for free public domain downloads in JPEG 2000 format.

name: UTexas LibGuides: Texas GIS Data
tagline: A comprehensive guide to open data portals for state-level geospatial data covering all of Texas.
description: This resource from the University of Texas Libraries compiles open data portals offering a wide variety of geospatial datasets specifically for the state of Texas. It advises users to consider federal sources for complementary data and provides practical tips for managing large datasets in GIS software. The guide helps users efficiently locate and utilize Texas-specific geospatial information.

name: Vermont Open Geodata Portal
tagline: Your source for geospatial data
description: The Vermont Open Geodata Portal serves as the official hub for geospatial data related to the state of Vermont. It provides a centralized repository for various datasets, making them accessible to the public, researchers, and government agencies. This portal facilitates data discovery and download for a wide range of geographic information system (GIS) applications.

name: VGIN Clearinghouse Data Downloads
tagline: The official hub for downloading geospatial data from the Virginia GIS Clearinghouse.
description: This platform serves as the central access point for users to acquire a wide array of geospatial data pertaining to the Commonwealth of Virginia. It functions as the main data download page for the Virginia Geographic Information Network (VGIN) Clearinghouse, providing structured access to various datasets.

name: Virginia Geospatial Data Resources
tagline: A comprehensive guide to accessing geospatial data from local government entities across Virginia.
description: This resource compiles links to geospatial data services offered by numerous counties and cities within Virginia. It provides direct access to open data portals, download pages, and contact information for GIS data. The guide is particularly useful for researchers, developers, and the public seeking authoritative local government spatial data.

name: Wake County Open Data
tagline: Wake County's official open data portal provides high-quality information and source data for public access.
description: The Wake County Open Data portal serves as a central hub for various stakeholders to access high-quality information and source data. It enables users to search, filter, download, and utilize API access for a wide array of datasets. This platform supports informed decision-making for businesses, government agencies, non-profits, and citizens.

name: Washington State Geospatial Open Data Portal
tagline: Explore and access Washington State's comprehensive collection of geospatial open data and applications.
description: This portal provides a centralized hub for accessing geospatial open data and applications from various Washington State agencies. It aims to enhance government efficiency and responsiveness by making critical spatial information readily available to the public. Users can explore a wide array of datasets and interactive maps across diverse categories.

name: WaterIsotopes.org
tagline: Tools and products designed to help you use water isotopes in your work.
description: This website provides a comprehensive resource for water isotope research and applications. It offers access to various data products, interactive tools, and archived information from scientific publications. The resources are designed to support researchers and professionals in utilizing stable water isotopes in their studies.

name: Web Soil Survey
tagline: Provides authoritative soil data and information produced by the National Cooperative Soil Survey.
description: Operated by the USDA Natural Resources Conservation Service (NRCS), this platform offers access to the world's largest natural resource information system. It provides soil maps and data for over 95 percent of the nation’s counties, serving as the single authoritative source for soil survey information.

name: Who’s On First
tagline: A global gazetteer providing stable identifiers and descriptive properties for places from continents to venues.
description: Who’s On First is a comprehensive gazetteer containing over 26 million records of places worldwide, ranging from continents to individual venues. Each entry features a stable identifier and a rich set of descriptive properties. The project offers its data in various formats, including GeoJSON and SQLite, and provides an API for programmatic access.

name: Wisconsin DNR Open Data Portal
tagline: A free web resource for locating, viewing, and downloading geospatial data from the Wisconsin Department of Natural Resources.
description: This portal serves as a central hub for geographic information systems (GIS) data maintained by the Wisconsin Department of Natural Resources. Users can explore, view, and download a variety of datasets, documents, apps, and maps related to Wisconsin's natural resources. It aims to provide public access to critical environmental and land-related information for various applications.

name: WisconsinView
tagline: Coordinating remote sensing imagery access and use in Wisconsin since 2004.
description: WisconsinView serves as a central hub for accessing and utilizing remote sensing imagery and LiDAR data specifically for the state of Wisconsin. This initiative facilitates the discovery and download of valuable geospatial datasets through its partnership with GeoData@Wisconsin. It aims to support various applications by providing resources and educational content related to satellite information and remote sensing.

name: World database of large urban areas
tagline: Database of the world's largest cities with population history and locations from 1950-2005.
description: This resource offers a comprehensive database of the world's largest urban areas, providing detailed information on their geographical locations and historical population trends from 1950 to 2005. The data is meticulously prepared using official UN statistics, ensuring accuracy and reliability for various analytical purposes. It is readily available for download in multiple formats, including those compatible with GIS software, Google Earth, and standard tabular formats, facilitating broad accessibility and integration into diverse projects.

name: WorldCereal
tagline: An open, user-friendly, and customizable global crop mapping system supporting global food security.
description: WorldCereal is a research project funded by the European Space Agency, dedicated to providing a free, cloud-based processing system. This system generates high-resolution custom crop location and type products at both local and global scales. It aims to enhance food security through advanced geospatial data and analysis.

name: WorldClim
tagline: A global climate data repository providing maps, graphs, tables, and downloadable data.
description: WorldClim provides comprehensive global climate data, including monthly temperature, precipitation, and bioclimatic variables. This resource serves as a vital repository for researchers and practitioners in various fields. The data is available for download at different spatial resolutions.

name: WOUDC
tagline: Discover, visualize, and access a global archive of ground-based ozone and UV radiation data.
description: WOUDC operates as a World Meteorological Organization (WMO) data center, supporting the Global Atmosphere Watch (GAW) program. It provides a comprehensive global archive of ground-based ozone and UV radiation data, enabling users to discover, visualize, and access these critical environmental datasets. The center is managed by Environment and Climate Change Canada.

name: WSDOT Geospatial Open Data Portal
tagline: Washington State Department of Transportation’s geospatial open data site for viewing and downloading spatial data.
description: This portal provides access to spatial data from the Washington State Department of Transportation (WSDOT). Users can explore, filter, and download various WSDOT spatial datasets, as well as access interactive and printable maps. It serves as a central hub for the state's transportation-related geospatial information.

name: WVGISTC
tagline: West Virginia's central hub for discovering and accessing GIS data for the state.
description: The West Virginia GIS Technical Center (WVGISTC) maintains a comprehensive GIS Data Clearinghouse. This platform serves as a central repository for geospatial data pertaining to West Virginia, enabling users to efficiently locate and access various datasets.

name: WyoGISC
tagline: Providing geospatial data and applications for the state of Wyoming.
description: The Wyoming Geographic Information Science Center (WyoGISC) at the University of Wyoming serves as a central hub for geospatial data and various applications. It supports research, education, and public access to critical GIS resources for the region.

name: YorkU LibGuides Geospatial Data
tagline: A research guide for accessing geospatial (GIS) data with a focus on Costa Rica at York University.
description: This comprehensive research guide from York University Library provides detailed information and resources for locating and accessing geospatial (GIS) data. It specifically highlights datasets pertinent to Costa Rica, serving as an invaluable resource for students and researchers. The guide outlines various methods for searching, browsing by topic, and ordering geospatial data.
